title: Senior Telco Service Engineer – Tieto Tech Consulting
description:
Job Description

Do you have a strong telecom engineering background and experience working with international customers? Do you want to be part of a global consulting organization while supporting a world-class telecom provider? Then this role is for you.

Tietoevry Create is looking for a Senior Telco Service Engineer to work on a strategic engagement with BICS, a global leader in international communications services. You will operate in a customer-facing, technically demanding role, ensuring high-quality service delivery across BICS' international telecom portfolio.

This position is based in Rio de Janeiro and operates in a global, multicultural environment, working closely with international customers and cross-functional teams.

Your responsibilities

  • Act as the main operational point of contact for selected international customers, ensuring seamless service delivery across BICS' telecom services.

  • Build and maintain long-term customer relationships through proactive engagement and customized operational interfaces, in close collaboration with technical and commercial teams.

  • Prepare and present monthly service performance reports and lead Service Review Meetings, driving continuous improvement through corrective actions and follow-up.

  • Serve as Single Point of Contact (SPOC) during incidents and escalations, coordinating resolution activities and delivering formal RFO/RCA documentation.

  • Advise customers on process improvements, reporting tools, and new services/products, supporting adoption of BICS' global offerings.

  • Collect and share customer feedback internally to support operational excellence and cross-functional collaboration.

  • Develop and maintain operational documentation, including service processes, planned work procedures, and escalation matrices.

Who we are looking for

  • Solid experience in the telecom industry, combining strong technical expertise with customer-facing responsibilities.

  • Proven technical knowledge of message flows in Voice, Signalling, and Roaming scenarios.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proactive and structured approach.

  • Customer-oriented mindset, with the ability to manage complex service issues and escalations.

  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken. Additional languages are an advantage.

  • University degree in Telecommunications or equivalent professional experience.

  • Flexibility and accountability, including willingness to travel internationally when required.

  • Strong crisis and incident management capabilities.

As a person, you are reliable, structured, and comfortable working in a global, cross-functional environment. You take ownership, communicate clearly, and value operational discipline and continuous improvement.

We also value

  • Experience working with international enterprise or carrier customers.

  • Familiarity with SLA-driven service environments and operational reporting.

  • Ability to work closely with both technical and commercial stakeholders.

We offer

  • Professional growth within a global consulting organization.

  • Long-term, meaningful projects with leading international clients.

  • Open and collaborative culture with strong knowledge sharing.

  • Flexible hybrid work model and focus on work-life balance.

Location: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
We perform background checks on all final candidates.
Tieto declines calls from recruitment agencies.

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

Diversity, equity and inclusion )

title: Analista de Inteligência de Negócios Pleno
description:
Descrição da vaga

Com uma trajetória de 95 anos, a
Americanas S.A
. está presente na vida de milhões de brasileiros.

Nossas +1600 lojas físicas estão distribuídas por todos os estados do Brasil, em mais de 800 cidades, levando nossos produtos e serviços a mais de 40 milhões de clientes em todo o país.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Nesse time, você terá a oportunidade de:

  • Analisar o comportamento das nossas lojas, apoiando leituras de base, segmentações e acompanhamento de indicadores;
  • Explorar e manipular grandes volumes de dados;
  • Analisar, interpretar e transformar dados em insights acionáveis, que influenciam decisões de negócio da cia;
  • Propor, construir e aprimorar KPIs estratégicos;
  • Apoiar os times de Operação e Planejamento de lojas;
  • Apoiar na criação de apresentações executivas, traduzindo análises complexas em narrativas que engajam diretoria e stakeholders.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que esperamos de você para essa vaga:

  • Ensino Superior Completo;
  • Habilidade para análise crítica e síntese de informações, transformando dados em insights acionáveis;
  • Conhecimento em manipulação de dados (SQL e Excel).
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de visualização de dados (Looker, Power BI ou similares).

Será um diferencial, caso você conheça:

  • Experiência com Looker Studio;
  • Familiaridade com indicadores de varejo (venda, margem, estoque).

OBS: Nossos processos seletivos estão sendo conduzidos totalmente online, portanto, fique atento nos emails e no spam.
Informações adicionais

Nossos benefícios:
Somos adeptos ao regime e benefícios CLT, oferecemos:

  • Vale Refeição;
  • Plano de saúde Bradesco;
  • Plano odontológico Amil;
  • Wellhub;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Fazemos nossa proposta salarial de acordo com o nosso plano de cargos e salários, sua pretensão salarial e avaliação técnica;
  • Somos uma Empresa Cidadã: 180 dias de licença maternidade e 20 dias licença paternidade;
  • Descontos em nossas lojas físicas, após o período de experiência;
  • Ambiente colaborativo: perfeito pra ensinar e aprender muito.

QUEM SOMOS

Quem Somos:
Somos a Americanas, uma das maiores varejistas do país, com mais de 95 anos de história. Nossa marca, amada pelos brasileiros, tem o propósito de resolver a vida das famílias de maneira simples e descomplicada. A integração das mais de 1.400 lojas, presentes em todos os estados, e um e-commerce que complementa a experiência do físico nos permitem a realização de uma estratégia de vendas multicanal e eficiente, com foco na geração de caixa e na rentabilidade. Venha construir o futuro com a gente

Nosso Jeito:
Nossa cultura é centrada no cliente, e buscamos constantemente soluções para aprimorar sua experiência. Valorizamos um jeito de trabalhar simples e descomplicado, que realmente gera impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Aqui, incentivamos o trabalho em equipe e a troca de ideias, pois acreditamos que é assim que crescemos juntos, tanto como profissionais quanto como pessoas.

Valores e Propósito:
Nosso propósito é
amar resolver a vida das pessoas
, de maneira simples e descomplicada, guiada por valores autênticos e que representem a nossa gente. Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma; priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência, seja nas lojas, no site ou no coração de milhões de famílias; valorizamos a pluralidade e a resiliência, além de reconhecer e cuidar das nossas pessoas. Acima de tudo, nos comprometemos a ter um impacto positivo em tudo o que fazemos .

Diversidade e inclusão:
A Americanas S.A. acredita que diferentes perspectivas enriquecem o ambiente de trabalho. Por isso, temos o objetivo de promover um lugar cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e acolhedor. Estamos construindo a cada dia uma cultura com base no respeito e valorização das diferenças, encorajando as pessoas a serem quem elas são, independente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, religião ou deficiência. title: Investor XP
description:
Sobre nós ​ 

A XP Inc. é uma das maiores instituições financeiras independente do Brasil, dona das marcas XP, Rico, Clear, XP Educação, InfoMoney, entre outras. Com mais de 4,6 milhões de clientes ativos e um valor superior a R$ 1,1 trilhão de ativos sob custódia, há 24 anos vem transformando o mercado financeiro para melhorar a vida das pessoas.

Com uma cultura marcante guiada por quatro valores - Sonho Grande, Espírito Empreendedor, Foco no Cliente e Mente Aberta - a XP Inc. está sempre em busca dos melhores talentos que tem ambição de fazer o impossível.

Sobre a Oportunidade


Na XP Inc., acreditamos que nosso time é a chave para o sucesso. Procuramos profissionais apaixonados pelo mercado financeiro, que compartilhem nossos valores: foco no cliente, espírito empreendedor, mente aberta e sonho grande.

Como Investor do time de Estratégia XP, você ficará responsável por trabalhar o asset allocation dos clientes de forma sofisticada, garantindo o enquadramento dos portfólios, de acordo com o suitability de cada cliente. O Investor ocupa a posição de referência técnica para o segmento e, além de garantir a qualidade na alocação dos clientes, atua sendo interface direta com as áreas de negócio da companhia, pensando estrategicamente quais ativos devem ser trabalhados e quais perfis de cliente têm maior propensão para determinada oferta. Geram insumos comerciais para todo o time, através de treinamentos, dados, materiais, etc.  

Saiba mais sobre nosso dia a dia no Instagram e no LinkedIn.

Confira nossas avaliações no Glassdoor.

O Que Procuramos


Pré-requisitos Essenciais:

  • Perfil comercial e fortes habilidades de comunicação;
  • Sólido conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RV, RF, Fundos, Previdência, entre outros); 
  • Conhecimento sobre asset alllocation, enquadramento, inteligência de base;
  • Morar no Rio de Janeiro, pois se trata de uma posição no modelo 100% presencial
  • Conhecimentos de macroeconomia e sua conjuntura atual; 
  • Experiência atendendo clientes Private ou Alta Renda; 
  • Se identificar com a nossa cultura;

Diferenciais:

  • CGA ou CFG ou CFP;

Desafios e Impacto

  • Atender os principais clientes da XP, em conjunto com o Banker do cliente; 
  • Ser referência técnica sobre produtos, planejamento financeiro e asset allocation no segmento; 
  • Identificar as melhores oportunidades de investimentos, garantindo assertividade comercial; 
  • Construir e disseminar as melhores práticas de investimentos entre os assessores;
  • Realizar consultoria de investimentos para garantir excelência no atendimento e monitorar os indicadores de qualidade; 
  • Atuar no nível tático e estratégico junto as áreas que impactam direta e indiretamente o cliente final. 
    *Obs.: a contratação é CLT.

Etapas do Processo


  1. Triagem inicial: Análise do currículo para verificar a adequação às qualificações e requisitos da vaga.

  2. Testes gerais: Avaliação do alinhamento cultural com o teste da Mindsight e teste de raciocínio lógico da Predictive Index.

  3. Entrevista com a equipe de Recrutamento: Discussão sobre as expectativas em relação à vaga e aos objetivos profissionais.

  4. Entrevista com a liderança: Uma conversa para discutir sua visão e como você pode contribuir para a equipe e a empresa.

  5. Entrevista com Head Comercial: Conversa para discutir sobre o seu perfil e características necessárias para contribuir com a operação

  6. Entrevista focada em cultura: Exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa para garantir um bom encaixe cultural.

  7. Oferta: Apresentação da proposta de trabalho, incluindo detalhes sobre remuneração e benefícios.


Benefícios:   

Saúde e bem-estar:

  • Plano de saúde sem coparticipação (inclusive, para dependentes)
  • Plano odontológico
  • Wellhub (Gympass)
  • Zenklub
  • Seguro de Vida
  • iFood Benefícios (VA e VR flexível)
  • Vale Transporte
  • New Value (clube de benefícios)
  • Licença parental: maternidade de 6 meses e paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Auxílio Creche

Vida Financeira

  • Fundos de Investimentos Exclusivos
  • Assessoria de Investimentos  
  • Cartão XP Visa Infinite sem anuidade  
  • Crédito (consignado, home equity, CCB Imobiliário, etc.) 

Modelo de Trabalho Presencial Flexível  

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função, podendo ser totalmente presencial para frentes de negócio e mais flexível para outras equipes.  
 
Seguimos um modelo com mais frequência presencial, mas sempre guiado por flexibilidade e autonomia com a responsabilidade da nossa cultura empreendedora. 

Aqui na XP Inc., valorizamos as interações pessoais e acreditamos no uso do escritório como uma ferramenta para potencializar nossas relações no trabalho.

*Ao seguir com a inscrição, você declara que leu, compreendeu e concorda com a Política de Privacidade do Grupo XP Inc. e de seus fornecedores e parceiros que apoiam com a realização do processo seletivo. O Grupo XP Inc. poderá utilizar de soluções de inteligência artificial para apoiar a equipe de recrutamento no decorrer do processo, o que poderá envolver o tratamento de seus dados pessoais para tal finalidade, conforme princípios da Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados e da Política de Privacidade do Grupo XP Inc.

A Tools4Change é uma empresa especializada em Captação de Recursos Face to Face (F2F), atuando diretamente em campo para conectar pessoas a causas sociais de grande impacto.

  • Postura ética e alinhamento com diretrizes da operação

Não é necessária experiência prévia em F2F.

Oferecemos treinamento inicial completo e acompanhamento contínuo.

DESENVOLVIMENTO E CRESCIMENTO

A Tools4Change possui um plano estruturado de crescimento, com progressão por níveis, baseado em desempenho, consistência e postura profissional.

Possibilidades reais de crescimento para:

  • Expert e Mestre F2F

  • Coordenação Regional

REMUNERAÇÃO E GANHOS

  • Comissões competitivas, acima do mercado

  • Valores crescentes de acordo com a evolução de nível
  • Bonificações por volume, ticket médio e perfil de doador
  • Bônus por eventos, viagens e indicação de novos captadores
  • Auxílio deslocamento

MODELO DE ATUAÇÃO E DIFERENCIAIS

  • Prestação de serviços (autônomo ou PJ)
  • Atuação 100% presencial em campo
  • Flexibilidade de dias e horários, conforme alinhamento operacional
  • Jornada média de 5 a 6 horas por dia (manhã ou tarde)
  • Acesso ao TotalPass (academia, pilates, terapia e bem-estar)
  • Possibilidade de viagens nacionais

CONSIDERAÇÕES FINAIS

Esta oportunidade é ideal para quem se identifica com trabalho externo, contato direto com pessoas e deseja construir uma carreira sólida na área social, de captação de recursos ou vendas externas.

title: HSS & Signalling Engineer
description:
About Us
1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider, delivering global connectivity solutions to enterprises and consumers. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform - including its own owned and operated global mobile core network, fully fledged in-house developed eSIM technology, and an extensive portfolio of telecom licenses - 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider across 40 countries worldwide.
We serve many of the world's leading banks, enterprises, and digital-first businesses, including neo-banks, global fast moving consumer goods companies, travel leaders, and payment service providers. Today, 1GLOBAL connects more than 70 million people and devices globally, enabling our customers to launch, scale, and innovate with confidence in the mobile ecosystem.
1GLOBAL is a profitable, fast-growing business. With full-year revenues in 2025 exceeding US$200 million and profits of over US$25 million, we generate strong cash flows to fund our growth allowing us to continuously invest in infrastructure, platform innovation, and global expansion. Recent years have marked a defining phase in our journey, with major enterprise and mass-consumer client wins accelerating our evolution into a global mobile connectivity powerhouse, purpose-built to enable consumer brands to enter and succeed with their own aspirations to offer telecommunications services to their clients.
Founded in 2022 by experienced technology entrepreneurs, Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL has rapidly emerged as a European technology leader shaping the future of global telecommunications. We operate as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) in 12 countries and as a regulated telecom operator in an additional 28 markets. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, our team of close to 500 experts across 15 countries is united by a single ambition: to redefine global mobile connectivity through technology, scale, and execution excellence.
About the Team
As a Network Engineering member, in the Signalling functional area, you will be responsible for proposing, analyse and define the requirements for new and existing services and systems, related with the signalling routing area and subscriber data management systems under the responsibility of the functional area. Prepare, design, test and provide new solutions or product changes of the already existing portfolio. Define and support the technology evolution roadmap for the systems under the functional area. Participate and support the other functional areas in cross functional projects.
About the Role
Collaboration with other Networks teams in defining and managing the projects for delivery of new solutions
Project delivery. Network design. Integration and migration strategy definition. Collaboration with other relevant departments. Responsible for end-to-end delivery
Design of new consumer and corporate telecom solutions
Creation of technical documentation (HLD's, LLD's, WO's, etc.) and maintain it over the lifecycle of the solutions
Perform implementations in live environment. Understanding of End to End system testing requirements
Follow-up and define Quality and Performance indicators
Capacity and Performance Analysis, Reporting and Improvement Solution Definition
Service & Resource configuration definition and implementation on requested systems
Work on complex solutions that influence the design of current products and addresses design issues for future products or technologies
Close relationship with external partners like carriers, service providers
Elaborate, and manage the process, for change requests to current partners in order to meet the network necessities
Control the network elements roadmap, being responsible for the necessary software/hardware upgrade during the components lifecycle
Generate and implement process improvements, including and especially cross-team processes
Documents the existing technology portfolio and proposes recommendations for improvements and/or alternatives
Requirements
About You
Must-haves
Proven experience on implementation of live solutions on mobile telecom (GSM, UMTS, LTE, IMS), networks design, capacity management, engineering and architecture
Knowledge of 3GPP, GSMA, ITU standards and specifications
Experience in the design, test and operation of signalling network functions, including STPs, DEA/DRAs and HLR/HSS
Experience in defining, establishing and maintaining signalling interconnects, SIGTRAN and DIAMETER based, using SCTP multi-homing
Experience with HLR/HSS, subscriber profiles, subscriber repositories and respective reference interfaces
Knowledge of IMS Architecture with understanding of IMS nodes, including Application Servers and its interaction with profile repositories
Experience in mobile services charging (online). Knowledge and experience Ro, Gy, Gx interfaces
Knowledge and experience with signalling protocols and routing including M3UA, M2PA, DIAMETER, as we well as upper layer protocols such as MAP, CAMEL, Sh, Cx
Knowledge of 5G SA networks, from a signalling (SCP and SEPP) and AUSF/UDM/UDR perspective
Experience with protocol analyser tools like Wireshark, Astelia, and ability to use them to troubleshoot networks errors/problems for the mentioned protocols
Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions
Familiar with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architecture(s) and landscape
English proficiency mandatory, other languages are a plus
Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience
Nice-to-haves
+3 years working on telecoms, designing and implementing mobile core networks
Previous experience with Nokia, Oracle, HPE products
Benefits
What We Offer?
CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
Quarterly performance bonuses to reward your hard work and achievements
Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
Extended parental leave - 180 days of maternity leave and 20 days of paternity leave
Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child
Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)
Why 1GLOBAL?
Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs
Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry
Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals
Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts
Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field
International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company
Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment
Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry
1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

Coren Técnico de Enfermagem ativo;
Pacote Office;
Desejável vivência com sistema de prontuário eletrônico do paciente (MV Soul).

title: Consultor Técnico Vacinas Adulto
description:
Site Name: Brazil - Rio de Janeiro
Posted Date: Feb
A GSK é uma empresa biofarmacêutica global com um propósito especial – unir ciência, tecnologia e talento para nos anteciparmos às doenças – para que possamos impactar positivamente a saúde de bilhões de pessoas e oferecer retornos mais fortes e sustentáveis aos acionistas – como uma organização onde as pessoas podem prosperar. Antecipamo-nos às doenças, prevenindo-as e tratando-as com inovação em medicamentos e vacinas especiais. Nós nos concentramos em quatro áreas terapêuticas: respiratória, imunologia e inflamação; oncologia; HIV; e doenças infecciosas – para impactar a saúde em escala.
Pessoas e pacientes em todo o mundo contam com os medicamentos e vacinas que fabricamos – por isso estamos comprometidos em criar um ambiente onde nosso pessoal possa prosperar e se concentrar no que é mais importante. Nossa cultura de ser ambicioso para os pacientes, responsável pelo impacto e fazer a coisa certa é a base de como, juntos, entregamos para pacientes, acionistas e nosso pessoal.
Na GSK, trabalhamos para transformar a saúde global por meio de soluções inovadoras que protegem vidas e promovem a prevenção de doenças.
O Consultor Técnico de Vacinas atua como especialista em prevenção, sendo responsável por otimizar a jornada de prevenção junto aos principais stakeholders deste ambiente de saúde, incluindo médicos, clínicas médicas e farmácias. Seu papel envolve compreender e influenciar a jornada do paciente desde a prescrição até o ato vacinal, com o propósito de contribuir para a ampliação do conceito de vacinação do adulto no Brasil.
Atua de forma integrada com profissionais de saúde por meio de diferentes canais, compreendendo o ecossistema de saúde e o mercado de prevenção. É responsável pelo gerenciamento estratégico de contas existentes e potenciais, com autonomia na gestão dos recursos sob sua responsabilidade. Trabalha em sinergia com equipes cross-funcionais internas e externas, garantindo o acesso adequado dos produtos GSK aos pacientes.
Essa posição terá como área de atuação Niterói/RJ.
Suas responsabilidades:
Esse cargo dá a VOCÊ a oportunidade de liderar atividades chaves para progredir na SUA carreira, algumas delas são:
Condução de discussões técnicas com profissionais de saúde, médicos, farmacêuticos e clínicas sobre vacinas e prevenção de doenças;
Negociação com clientes e stakeholders, co-desenvolvendo campanhas e soluções personalizadas (protocolos, diretrizes, eventos, entre outros) que geram valor mútuo, com foco na adesão às campanhas e no aumento de pessoas imunizadas;
Identificação de pontos críticos e oportunidades de ações e campanhas que impactem positivamente a experiência e o resultado nas jornadas de prevenção;
Interpreta dados de mercado e gera insights estratégicos para apoiar decisões e campanhas.
Por que VOCÊ?
Suas qualificações:
Estamos à procura de profissionais com essas características para alcançar nossos objetivos:
Ensino Superior Completo;
Necessária Atuação e conhecimento em Doenças Cardiovasculares e Metabólicas (CVMD)
Experiência prévia com visitação médica e geração de demanda na Indústria farmacêutica;
Conhecimento sobre patologias, gestão de clientes, gestão de territórios;
Conhecimentos básicos ou superiores do Pacote Office (Word, Power Point, Excel);
Posicionamento ousado para transpor desafios, bom relacionamento em equipe e iniciativa;
Disponibilidade de viagens;
CNH Válida - Categoria B.
Seu diferencial:
Contudo, se você tiver os requisitos a seguir, será um plus para a sua inscrição:
Experiência prévia com atendimento nas linhas de cardiologia, endocrinologia;
Experiência prévia em lançamento de medicamentos de alta complexidade.
Why GSK?
Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we're committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

When applying, you may also choose to provide personal information, which helps us ensure a more inclusive selection process. title: Programme Analyst
description:
Result of Service

The Programme Analyst reports to the Head of Brazil Office. He/She shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under these Terms of Reference. The consultant will work in close collaboration with the UN-Habitat's operational and technical teams.

Work Location

Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Expected duration

Six (6) months, with possibility of renewal

Duties and Responsibilities

Background The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, local authorities, and other partners for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda, with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan, and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis on developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative, and socially fairer urban economic, social, and environmental policies. Through a partnership with the Rio de Janeiro State Water and Sewage Company (CEDAE), UN-Habitat started a project to improve the quality of basic water and sanitation services in CEDAE's territory of operation, ensuring inclusive, gender-responsive, sustainable solutions that are fully aligned with the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). To properly implement this project, a Programme Analyst is required to ensure the good execution of the work programme. Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Programme Analyst reports to the Head of Brazil Office, who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The Programme Analyst will support the implementation of the project, and its activities, with the following responsibilities: a) Provide technical advice and support the execution of technical activities related to the project. b) Provide managerial support and coordinate the overall implementation of project's work programme, including development, approval and implementation of activities. c) Maintain close communication with counterparts and local partners, such as the governments, civil society organizations, universities, private sector, etc., under supervision. d) Perform technical, administrative and management activities to ensure that the project meets the objectives in terms of deadlines, budget and quality. e) Provide appropriate technical support to implement activities related to the following areas: i. Capacity building and development. ii. Collection, production, analysis and management of data, information and urban indicators. iii. Public policies. iv. Strategic and project planning, monitoring and implementation. v. Social mobilization and participation. vi. Communities' projects. vii. Construction management. viii. Project funding. ix. Effective advocacy, monitoring and partnership. f) Provide information for the systematization and exchange of successful practices and experiences. g) Conduct technical activities to ensure that the project meets deadlines and objectives. h) Provide inputs for the identification and mitigation of risks, including relevant challenges or omissions and other situations that may affect the development and implementation of the project. i) Attend meetings and conferences promoted by UN-Habitat and the project's partners. j) Document expert group meetings, forums, consultations, training events and other activities related to the planning, development and implementation of the project. k) Prepare reports to partners, internal reports, etc. at various stages of the projects. l) Perform other duties which may be requested by the supervisor. m) Participate in missions as requested. The consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The Programme Analyst will support the implementation of the project. The consultant shall be paid a monthly allowance, upon presentation and approval by the Head of Brazil Office of monthly activities' report.

Qualifications/special skills

Education Required:
• Bachelor's degree in Architecture and Urbanism, Geography, Law, International Relations or related fields is required.
• Postgraduate degree (Lato Sensu or Stricto Sensu) in Architecture and Urbanism, Geography, Sociology, Law, Social Work, Social Sciences, or related fields is required, or additional four (4) years of relevant experience to the post, beyond the requirement. Work experience:
• A minimum of six (6) years of experience in designing, reviewing, or implementing projects/programmes related to urban planning, water and sanitation and/or infrastructure in urban communities in Brazil is required.
• Experience in project management is required.
• Experience with water and sanitation is desirable.
• Previous experience working in the United Nations is desirable. Skills:
• Good computer skills in Windows and Office packages and Web search engines are required.
• Goods skills in AutoCAD e GIS technologies is desirable.
• Good handling of technological tools and use of software and online platforms is desirable.
• Good handling of online event and conference tools is desirable.
• Good knowledge on project management methodologies is desirable. Competencies
• Professionalism: Experience working in an inter-institutional environment, project management, monitoring-evaluation. approaches and strategies regarding good urban governance and local and regional development.
• Planning and organization: Professional approach to work, strong sense of responsibility, operate with minimal supervision. Proven organizational skills and ability to manage a workload efficiently and within set deadlines.
• Communication: Ability to write clearly and effectively. Listen to others, interpret messages correctly, and respond appropriately. Show openness in information sharing and keep everyone informed. solid abstract reasoning skills together with a proven capacity to write documents for diverse audiences.
• Teamwork: Ability to work with teams, demonstrate leadership, conflict management, and consensus facilitation skills. ability to work in a multicultural and multi-ethnic environment, and to respect diversity. sensitivity to the main streaming of vulnerability. willingness and ability to work in difficult environments. Knowledge Management
• The person must know the processes, procedures, and norms of UN-Habitat, to guarantee an adequate quality of the activities described above, following the standards of the organization.
• The person will propose formats and procedures that allow for the efficient implementation of the activities related to project development.
• The person must know the file of the Office, work with it, and ensure its proper maintenance, accessibility for all staff, and due updating.
• The person will prepare databases related to the project running.
• The person will make sure that all relevant technical information will be adequately shared with the correspondent staff.
• The person will ensure that all produced material will be fit-for-purpose and delivered, in an organized way, for posterior consultation and use of the Agency.
• The person will only share the information produced with the team agency, assuring the privacy of the content.

Languages


• English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat, and Spanish is the working language of the Regional Office.
• For the post advertised, fluency in Portuguese is required.
• Working knowledge of English or Spanish is desirable.

Additional Information

Travel details: Applicable The consultant must be available to travel to the places related to the activities in the country, if requested by the Head of Brazil Office. Missions will be coordinated and financed by UN-Habitat, according to the United Nations travel rules and guidelines. Remuneration LICA 3 UNOPS Salary Scale. Notes Appointment against this post is on local basis and only nationals from Brazil or external candidates who hold a permanent visa in Brazil may apply. The extension of this contract is subject to availability of funds and/or performance. Any contract extension is not automatic. It is required for all the curricular information to be inserted into the system, which may take a few hours. Only complete applications in English will be considered. All applications will be treated with the strictest confidence. Due to the volume of applications received, receipt of applications cannot be acknowledged individually. Only short-listed applicants will be contacted. Applications should be submitted through INSPIRA and must include all documents required at the system, please be ready to include the following information at the "Candidate Profile" (CP) at Inspira:
• Cover memo (maximum 1 page)
• Educational Background (incl. dates)
• Professional Experience (assignments, tasks, achievements, duration by years/ months)
• Expertise and preferences regarding location of potential assignments
• Other Experience and Expertise (e.g., Internships/ voluntary work, etc.) * * Please note that Internships, self-employment, and part-time count as 50%. In addition to it, note experience not relevant to the position will not be considered. All applications should be submitted to: Inspira UN-HABITAT does not charge a fee at any stage of the recruitment process. If you have any questions concerning people or companies claiming to be recruiting on behalf of these offices and requesting the payment of a fee, please contact:

No Fee

title: General Interest
description:
The Company You'll Join


Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta's platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta's Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don't work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta's software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it's a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital. 

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

Sobre a empresa


Carta é uma empresa americana com sede em São Francisco, na Califórnia. Temos escritórios em diversas cidades dos Estados Unidos, bem como no Canadá, Austrália, Cingapura e Brasil. A Carta foi fundada em 2012; em agosto de 2021, foi avaliada em 7.4 bilhões de dólares. Nossa missão é "create more owners" (criar mais proprietários). Nós ajudamos pessoas a terem participação na riqueza criada por empresas de capital fechado — as quais ainda não participam de transações na bolsa de valores. Essa riqueza é representada por "equity" ou cotas de participação nessas empresas. Fundadores de empresas de capital fechado oferecem equity a investidores em troca de investimentos que serão usados para o crescimento da empresa. Frequentemente, eles também oferecem equity para seus funcionários como parte de seu plano de benefícios, além dos salários.

A Carta torna o gerenciamento de equity mais fácil para fundadores, investidores e funcionários. Nós começamos nossa jornada com um produto desenvolvido para ajudar empresas a gerenciar suas tabelas de capitalização (ou "cap tables", em inglês). Simplificar o gerenciamento de cap tables é um grande problema nos Estados Unidos, onde empresas de capital fechado têm centenas ou milhares de investidores. Este não é um problema que chegou ao Brasil: grande parte das empresas de capital fechado no Brasil ainda não oferece equity aos seus funcionários como parte da remuneração — mas essa é uma realidade que esperamos mudar.

Na Carta, somos prestativos, transparentes, justos e amáveis. Somos executores incansáveis, pensadores não convencionais. Leia mais sobre nossos princípios operacionais e traços de identidade.

Sobre as equipes


Nosso escritório no Brasil fica localizado no Rio de Janeiro e comporta diferentes times. Nós estamos entusiasmados em oferecer oportunidades para pessoas com deficiência em qualquer um desses times. Os mesmos incluem - mas não estão limitados a - engenharia, produto e projeto, suporte, operações e equipes G&A. Nossos colaboradores fazem parte de times distribuídos internacionalmente, sendo importante o domínio do inglês. Trabalhar na Carta é uma oportunidade de construir conexões e aprender com pessoas talentosas em todo o mundo. 

Sobre a oportunidade


A Carta está sempre interessada em trazer profissionais que sejam inspirados por nossa missão. Embora tenhamos muitas oportunidades disponíveis listadas aqui em nossa página de carreiras, se não houver posições listadas atualmente que você acredita que se encaixam melhor em seu conjunto de habilidades, inscreva-se aqui e nos informe em que tipo de trabalho você estaria interessado.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência na análise de dados e na elaboração de recomendações estratégicas.
  • Conhecimento em regulamentações relacionadas ao clima e à sustentabilidade.
  • Proatividade e capacidade de trabalhar em equipe multidisciplinar.

A Environmental Resources Management (ERM) é uma fornecedora líder global de serviços de consultoria ambiental, de saúde, segurança, riscos e sociais, além de serviços relacionados à sustentabilidade. Possuímos mais de 160 escritórios em mais de 40 países e territórios, empregando mais de 5.500 pessoas que trabalham em projetos em todo o mundo. A ERM está comprometida em fornecer um serviço consistente, profissional e da mais alta qualidade para gerar valor para nossos clientes. Trabalhamos com muitas das empresas da Fortune 500 Global, fornecendo soluções inovadoras para empresas e clientes governamentais selecionados, ajudando-os a compreender e gerenciar os desafios de sustentabilidade que o mundo enfrenta cada vez mais.

Há mais de 50 anos, trabalhamos com clientes em todo o mundo e em diversos setores da indústria para ajudá-los a compreender e gerenciar seus impactos ambientais, de saúde, segurança, riscos e sociais. Os principais setores que atendemos incluem Petróleo e Gás, Mineração, Energia e Manufatura, Química e Farmacêutica. Todos enfrentam desafios críticos de sustentabilidade e nossos clientes nessas e em muitas outras áreas contam com nossa capacidade de ajudá-los a operar de forma mais sustentável, o que gera um impacto positivo em nosso planeta.

Na ERM, sabemos que criar um ambiente de trabalho diverso, equitativo e inclusivo é parte essencial para tornar nossa empresa um ótimo lugar para construir uma carreira.

Se você deseja ler mais sobre Diversidade, Equidade, Inclusão e Pertencimento (DEIB) na ERM, você pode visitar nosso site ou ler sobre nosso progresso no Relatório de Sustentabilidade de 2024.

title: Human Resource Administrator
description:
• Located in Barra da Tijuca - Rio de Janeiro, Brazil


• Full Time Position, Monday – Friday 8:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m.

The Company

Katalyst Data Management (KDM) provides end-to-end subsurface data management solutions for the oil and gas industry. From data capture and verification to data storage and organization, to marketing data online, our specialized data services cater for small enterprises, through to large multinational and corporate data centers. KDM's web-based iGlass services and their related controls, including system redundancy, are key differentiators in providing and maintaining high availability, 24/7 access for customers. Innovation and commitment have enabled KDM to provide excellence in both technologies and service qualities.

Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities

The Human Resources Administrator provides day-to-day administrative and operational support across core  Human Resources functions in Brazil, ensuring compliance with Brazilian labor legislation (CLT), applicable collective bargaining agreements, and internal company policies. This role supports employee lifecycle processes including onboarding/offboarding, employee record maintenance, benefits administration support, recruitment coordination, HR reporting, and employee inquiry response. The HR Administrator handles confidential employee information in accordance with the Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (LGPD) and maintains accurate documentation required for audits and statutory reporting.

Tasks:


• Support the end-to-end onboarding and offboarding process, including collection and validation of mandatory personal documents, coordination of pre-employment medical examinations (ASO), and preparation/maintenance of employment documentation.


• Maintain accurate physical and digital employee personnel files (contracts, amendments, acknowledgements, and supporting documentation) and ensure records are up to date.


• Coordinate HR data entry, updates, and reporting in HRIS (e.g., ADP WorkforceNow or local systems) and support required submissions and recordkeeping for Brazil (e.g., eSocial data coordination as applicable).


• Provide administrative support for benefits and statutory programs, responding to employee questions regarding benefits and leave (e.g., vacation scheduling, meal/transportation vouchers where applicable) and routing complex items to HR leadership or vendors.


• Coordinate recruitment administration, including job postings support, interview scheduling, candidate communications, and onboarding logistics.


• Support compliance activities by tracking key dates and documents (e.g., probationary period checkpoints, contract renewals for fixed-term hires, and required acknowledgements).


• Assist with internal HR communications and policy administration, including distribution of policies, collection of employee acknowledgements, and maintaining policy records.


• Partner with local stakeholders (e.g., accounting/payroll providers) to support timely processing by providing accurate employee data and documentation, while maintaining confidentiality and data privacy controls.


• Contribute to continuous improvement of HR administrative processes, templates, and checklists to increase accuracy, speed, and compliance readiness.

Compliance and Data Privacy (Brazil):


• Work is performed in alignment with CLT requirements and any applicable collective bargaining agreements, including proper documentation of the employment relationship.


• Maintain confidentiality and process personal data in accordance with LGPD principles (purpose limitation, necessity, security, and accountability).


• Support accurate recordkeeping needed for statutory obligations and inspections, escalating questions to HR leadership or legal counsel as appropriate.

Skills and Knowledge:


• Working knowledge of core HR administration practices and familiarity with Brazilian Labor concepts (CLT) and HR documentation standards.


• High attention to detail, strong organization, and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.


• Professional communication skills: English proficiency (written and verbal) required.


• Discretion and integrity when handling confidential employee information and sensitive issues.


• Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook) and comfort learning HRIS/payroll portals.


• Strong customer-service orientation and ability to work collaboratively with employees and cross-functional partners.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

This position has no supervisory responsibilities; however, it provides administrative support and guidance to employees on HR processes and directs questions to appropriate stakeholders when needed.

Position Type and Expected Hours of Work:

This is a full-time position. As such, the Human Resource Administrator is eligible to participate in the regional benefits program offered to Katalyst employees.

Standard days and hours of work are Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., with flexibility as needed to support business requirements and local timekeeping practices.

Travel:

Occasional local travel may be required for this position. If an offsite meeting or errand is requested, eligible mileage reimbursement will follow company policy and applicable local guidance.

Required Education and Experience


• Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience.


• Three (3) to five (5) years of experience in HR administration, HR operations, or a similar role.


• Experience supporting onboarding documentation, personnel file maintenance, and benefits/employee inquiries.


• Experience working with HRIS platforms (e.g., ADP WorkforceNow) and coordinating HR data updates and reporting.HR certification or coursework (local or international) is a plus.

Resumes can be submitted to our Career Center by visiting our Katalyst Career Center.

title: Network Solution Architect
description:
About Us
1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider, delivering global connectivity solutions to enterprises and consumers. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform – including its own owned and operated global mobile core network, fully fledged in-house developed eSIM technology, and an extensive portfolio of telecom licenses – 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider across 40 countries worldwide.

We serve many of the world's leading banks, enterprises, and digital-first businesses, including neo-banks, global fast moving consumer goods companies, travel leaders, and payment service providers. Today, 1GLOBAL connects more than 70 million people and devices globally, enabling our customers to launch, scale, and innovate with confidence in the mobile ecosystem.

1GLOBAL is a profitable, fast-growing business. With full-year revenues in 2025 exceeding US$200 million and profits of over US$25 million, we generate strong cash flows to fund our growth allowing us to continuously invest in infrastructure, platform innovation, and global expansion. Recent years have marked a defining phase in our journey, with major enterprise and mass-consumer client wins accelerating our evolution into a global mobile connectivity powerhouse, purpose-built to enable consumer brands to enter and succeed with their own  aspirations to offer telecommunications services to their clients.

Founded in 2022 by experienced technology entrepreneurs, Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL has rapidly emerged as a European technology leader shaping the future of global telecommunications. We operate as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) in 12 countries and as a regulated telecom operator in an additional 28 markets. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, our team of close to 500 experts across 15 countries is united by a single ambition: to redefine global mobile connectivity through technology, scale, and execution excellence.
About the Team

As an Architect inside the Network Engineering department, you will act as a Solution Architect for new products, services and technologies in 1Global, acting as a point of contact towards internal and external customers. Effectively work closely with Product and Marketing, but also with all different technical stakeholders and vendors, in shaping, designing, testing, and implementing new solutions. The Architect is responsible for leading the requirements analysis process, in close contact with all relevant stakeholders, to a refined and clear scope, allowing a solution to be created, documented and planned to be implemented.
We are open to hiring for this position in São Paulo, Brazil. The successfully hired candidate will receive onboarding and training in Lisbon, gaining valuable skills while experiencing one of Europe's most dynamic and renowned cities.
About the Role

  • Iterates with the customer (internal and external) and other stakeholders to determine the technical requirements, risks, technical impacts, and recommendations
  • Design of new consumer and corporate telecom solutions
  • Collaborates with technical teams in defining reliable, modular, scalable, and customer-centric solutions, as well as planning and reviewing solutions
  • Design and present solutions in documents and workshops. For the solution identifies the impacts, efforts and the resources needed
  • Market prospection of new solutions through elaboration and analysis of Request for Information/Proposal/Quotation processes and negotiation with potential suppliers
  • Follow up of new technology trends in the Telecom industry and identifying interesting solutions for the product portfolio
  • Definition and follow up of company technological evolution roadmaps
  • Documents the existing technology portfolio and proposes recommendations for improvements and / or alternatives
  • Ensure and control quality of documentation execution (HLD's, LLD's, WO's, etc.)
  • Ensure and control implementation quality. Understanding of End to End system testing requirements
  • Ensure the network is compliant with industry standards and regulations
  • Capacity and Performance Analysis, Reporting and Improvement Solution Definition
  • Work on complex solutions that influence the design of current products and addresses design issues for future products or technologies. Enhance, simplify, and optimize existing applications and processes
  • Evolves the engineering maturity to be on par with the non-functional and functional state-of-the-art
  • Communicates transparently to the whole business
  • Reaches out to other teams and works towards alignment and overall continuous improvement

Requirements

About You

Must-haves

  • Excellent understanding of Mobile Networks and its architectures
  • Experience with MVNO architecture(s) and landscape. Familiar with roaming environment, including its technical, commercial and regulatory aspects
  • Solid knowledge of networking principles & protocols, including security
  • Experience in network protocols like MAP, CAMEL, SIGTRAN, DIAMETER, SIP
  • Knowledge and experience of OCS and Gy/Sy interfaces
  • Experience with VoLTE and VoWiFi
  • Experience with LTE, 5G, IMS, IP technologies and protocols
  • Familiar with cloud-based solutions and virtualization technologies
  • High Level Designs and Low Level Designs. Experience developing and presenting internal and external documents
  • Experience with 5G Core Mobile Networks
  • Experience with monitoring tools and protocols in Mobile Networks
  • Anticipates problems and addresses them before they cause impact
  • Understands how big-picture goals inform technical details and vice-versa
  • Ability to work in complex environments (multi-cultural/multi-country/geographically distributed teams)
  • High attention to detail. Doesn't leave things to be addressed or left undone
  • Business oriented, capable to engage and discuss with non technical persons in order to create technical requirements
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • English proficiency mandatory, other languages are a plus
  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience


Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with cloud applications monitoring and analytics is a plus
  • Experience with AI/ML cloud based service assurance is a plus
  • Extensive working experience on telecoms, designing and implementing mobile core networks

Benefits

What we offer?

  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Extended parental leave - 180 days of maternity leave and 20 days of paternity leave.
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.


1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

title: Pore Pressure and Fracture Gradient
description:
Role Synopsis
The central Western Hemisphere Pore Pressure and Geomechanics team located in Houston is looking for a professional specialist to join the Western Hemisphere central PPFG/Geomechanics team in Rio de Janeiro.
The successful candidate will and support well planning and execution for in Brazil, as well as work with the broader team supporting all of the Western Hemisphere. This team supports all of the Gulf of Mexico, Trinidad, and Western Hemisphere exploration. (including Brazil and Canada) producing assets and exploration activities offshore.
In addition, the team is becoming increasingly involved in appraisal and development work for Carbon Collection Utilization and Storage (CCUS) in the US. We work closely with our subsurface and wells teams both in the Western Hemisphere as well as globally to safely and optimally deliver wells for bp.
The Senior Specialist is an integral member of the cross-disciplinary well delivery teams and provides support for well planning and execution by developing geologically sound and compliant pore and fracture pressure forecasts and wellbore stability models. Is involved in all aspects of well planning from early concept, through detailed well planning, execution and post well analysis. During implement the specialist also collaborates with the Real Time Collaboration Operations Center on pressure detection efforts and with subsurface, drilling, and completions to incorporate pore pressure and wellbore stability takeaways and understanding to safely and successfully implement the wells.
Primary Accountabilities
Pore Pressure and Fracture Pressure Forecasting:
Is encouraged to integrate multiple types of indicators and observations in a geologic context to generate a pre-drill pore pressure and fracture gradient (PPFG) forecast. This may include: pressure from seismic velocities, offset well data such as measured pressures, connection gases, log derived pressures in shale, and basin models for building the pore pressure model and log data, drilling events/data, mini-frac/leakoff test data, lost circulation events, impact of reservoir depletion and lithology variations to constrain fracture gradient and minimum stress.
Then will integrate their work with others on the multi-disciplinary well planning team to optimize the pattern on the selection of drilling fluid type/weight, casing string compose, setting depths, potential geo-hazards and mitigation techniques. They will also be able to communicate the technical work as well as the risks and mitigations to a wide range of partners, ranging from the drilling team, the Operations team supervising the well, leadership as well as co-owners and governmental regulators.
Operational Support for Pore Pressure Detection as required for sophisticated development or exploration wells in collaboration with the remote collaboration center; including real-time model calibration, kick analysis, gas and breathing analysis and losses investigations as well as interpretation of formation integrity tests. Also, will be responsible for communicating the updated PPFG model and forecast going forward to the operations team and to recommend potential changes to mudweight or drilling strategy and potential locations for pressure points.
Drillability Assessment: work closely with wells to develop wellbore strengthening model and implementation plan for drilling through depleted reservoirs.
Wellbore stability analysis: Developing wellbore stability models as the basis for providing minimum mud weight recommendations for drilling and completing wells. There will be an emphasis on analysis and integration of data from multiple sources e.g. log data, drilling data, cavings analysis, image and caliper log analysis etc.
Operational assessment: contribute to Reservoir Design and Operating Limits, broaching analyses, zonal isolation assessment, alternate well design, abandonment deviation/risk assessments. Participate in risk assessments to represent the PPFG, zonal isolation and broaching risks.
Participation in subsurface related non-productive time (NPT) analyses and investigations.
Support development and implementation of a best-in-class PPFG and Geomechanics toolkit.
Represent BP externally as required at industry meetings and JIPs etc.
Mentor for less experienced team members
Education
Engineering, Science, Geoscience, Geomechanics or Mathematics
Crucial Criteria
Seasoned and Vast experience in relevant oilfield (drilling PPFG/geomechanics) with operator or service company.
Strong communication skills with the ability to distill complicated technical work to a variety of interested parties.
Ability to work with cross-disciplinary teams and going for priorities to deliver ambitious wells.
The candidate must be familiar with PPFG, geomechanics, drilling and subsurface aspects of Well Planning and Execution.
Desirable Qualifications
Previous PPFG experience with an operator, ideally planning and performing Brazil pre-salt wells; previous geomechanics experience such as wellbore stability and formation pressure integrity tests, strong geology and geophysics background and experience with well planning.
Experience generating pre-drill PPFG forecasts for offshore wells in both development and exploration settings.
Awareness of Geology, Petrophysics, Basin Modelling, Processing Geophysics, Reservoir Geomechanics, Drilling Engineering, Rig Systems, and Well Control.
Software proficiency and coding capability (e.g., VBA, Python, Techlog and Petrel).
Why join us
At bp, we support our people to learn and grow in a diverse and ambitious environment. We believe that our team is strengthened by diversity. We are committed to encouraging an inclusive environment in which everyone is respected and treated fairly.
There are many aspects of our employees' lives that are meaningful, so we o8er benefits ) to enable your work to fit with your life. These benefits can include flexible working options, a generous paid parental leave policy, and excellent retirement benefits, among others
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
BEWARE – RECRUITMENT FRAUD
It has come to our attention that there are a number of fraudulent emails from people pretending to work for bp. Please be advised that we do not require any forms of payment or course by applicants to be considered for open positions.

title: Project Management Support
description:
Job Highlight
PT - Standar TDR Clasificado
Esta vaga tem como objetivo identificar um grupo de candidatos a Project Management Support Senior Associate para projetos existentes e futuros no Brasil.
PORTFÓLIO ATUAL: O portfólio do Brasil atualmente implementa 17 projetos – 13 projetos de infraestrutura que variam de baixa, média e alta complexidade, bem como 4 projetos que gerenciam logística para ajuda humanitária, iniciativas de desenvolvimento social e parcerias público-privadas. Os projetos existentes incluem a prestação de apoio ao Fundo Nacional de Desenvolvimento da Educação na finalização da construção de escolas para comunidades indígenas e tradicionais; a gestão da implementação da compensação por dano moral coletivo para bairros afetados por subsidência de mineração em Maceió; o apoio ao Ministério das Cidades na elaboração de 120 planos municipais de redução de risco de desastres (apenas consultoria); e a conclusão da Etapa 1 do Campus da Universidade Federal da Integração Latino-Americana (UNILA) em Foz do Iguaçu; entre outros. Esses projetos, e outros semelhantes no pipeline, são implementados em estreita colaboração com o doador e/ou beneficiários, e variam em complexidade, escopo e valor, de US$ 4 milhões a US$ 150 milhões.
PIPELINE – INSTALAÇÕES INSTITUCIONAIS: O pipeline atual inclui oportunidades para gerenciar o design e/ou a construção e supervisão de instalações institucionais — como edifícios de escritórios públicos, hospital, museu, escolas e projetos de água e saneamento — localizadas em Brasília, Foz do Iguaçu, São Paulo, Pará e outras localidades em todo o Brasil.
Apoiar o sucesso dos projetos por meio de suporte contínuo e excelência operacional.
EN - Standar TDR Clasificado
This vacancy aims to identify a pool of Project Management Support Senior Associate candidates for existing and future projects in Brazil.
CURRENT PORTFOLIO: The Brazil portfolio currently implements 17 projects - 13 infrastructure projects ranging from low, medium and high complexity, as well as 4 projects that manage logistics for humanitarian aid, social development initiatives, and private-public partnerships. Existing projects include the provision of support to the National Education Development Fund in finalizing the construction of schools for indigenous and traditional communities; Managing the implementation of collective moral damage compensation for neighborhoods affected by mining subsidence in Maceio, supporting the Ministry of Cities in preparing 120 municipal disaster risk reduction plans(advisory only); and concluding Stage 1 of the Campus of the Federal University for Latin American Integration (UNILA) in Foz do Iguaçu; among others. These Projects, and others similar in pipeline, are implemented in close collaboration with the donor and/or beneficiaries, and range in complexity, scope and price from $4 million to $150 million.
PIPELINE - INSTITUTIONAL FACILITIES: The current pipeline includes opportunities to manage the design, and/or construction and supervision of institutional facilities—such as public office buildings, hospital, museum, schools, and water and sanitation projects —located in Brasília, Foz do Iguaçu, São Paulo, Pará, and other locations across Brazil.
Supporting project success through seamless support and operational excellence.
Role Purpose
PT
O Project Management Support Senior Associate fornece apoio técnico, administrativo e logístico para garantir a entrega eficiente e eficaz das operações do projeto. O titular do cargo contribui para a coordenação e execução dos processos cotidianos de gestão de projetos, assegurando a conformidade com os padrões e procedimentos do UNOPS. A função é focada no parceiro e orientada a resultados no apoio à implementação oportuna dos projetos
EN
The Project Management Support Senior Associate provides technical, administrative and logistical support to ensure the efficient and effective delivery of project operations. The incumbent contributes to the coordination and execution of day-to-day project management processes, ensuring compliance with UNOPS standards and procedures. The role is stakeholder-focused and results-oriented in supporting timely project implementation.
Functions / Key Results Expected
PT - Standar TDR Clasificado
Monitoramento e Relatórios de Projetos
Apoiar o supervisor no monitoramento da implementação do projeto e do desempenho financeiro para garantir a conformidade com as regras, regulamentos e padrões de relatórios do UNOPS.
Preparar e manter relatórios de desembolso financeiro e atualizações de progresso em coordenação com Finanças e unidades relevantes.
Manter documentação abrangente do projeto, incluindo registros financeiros, arquivos de auditoria e lançamentos no Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) (oneUNOPS), garantindo precisão e integridade.
Acompanhar orçamentos do projeto, fluxo de caixa e despesas. Identificar variações, propor revisões orçamentárias e iniciar ações corretivas quando necessário.

title: Estágio em Design
description:
Olá, nós somos o CESAR

Somos um centro de inovação que há mais de duas décadas forma pessoas e impulsiona organizações, potencializando suas estratégias digitais. Resolvemos problemas complexos e desafiadores em um ambiente de trabalho descontraído, descentralizado e repleto de benefícios para nossos colaboradores - que atuam como protagonistas, interagindo diretamente com clientes de escala global.

Se você é uma pessoa que é aberta para aprender coisas novas, que tem espírito de time, que gosta de desafios, que busca transformar e impactar positivamente, por meio da educação, a vida das pessoas e entende que a diversidade é fundamental para uma sociedade mais justa e inovadora, a nossa vaga de Pessoa Estagiária em Design foi feita pra você

Quais são as responsabilidades e atribuições que você vai ter?

  • Apoiar os professores no planejamento das atividades pedagógicas em componentes curriculares de design.
  • Apoiar e participar de treinamentos, oficinas, workshops, eventos e palestras da área de design.
  • Participar de aulas auxiliando em atividades práticas e complementares, visando o processo de ensino-aprendizagem.
  • Registrar o conteúdo programático, notas e frequência, quando necessário, no sistema acadêmico da escola.
  • Orientar os estudantes na aprendizagem, execução de exercícios, pesquisas e uso do material didático.
  • Participar de reuniões de alinhamento do conselho e também de formações continuadas ofertadas pela instituição.
  • Apoiar a Coordenação em atividades administrativas e pedagógicas.

Buscamos alguém que conheça alguns dos seguintes requisitos:

  • Estar matriculado em cursos de Design, Design gráfico ou industrial, Artes Visuais ou Publicidade.
  • Domínio da suíte de escritório do Google.
  • Conhecimentos em ferramentas de edição, como por exemplo, Inkscape, Gimp, Figma, CapCut, Krita, entre outros.
  • Conhecimentos em Blender podem ser um diferencial.
  • Portfólio de criações (mesmo que sejam poucas peças feitas na faculdade).
  • Disponibilidade para aprendizagem de softwares, práticas e metodologias;
  • Interesse em desenvolver competências e habilidades para o ensino de design;
  • Disposição para escrita técnica e científica – artigos e afins;
  • Propensão para organização e sistematização;
  • Capacidade para elaborar conteúdos de aulas.
  • Disponibilidade de 4h diárias, 100% presenciais, de Segunda a Sexta (20h semanais, manhã ou tarde).

Aqui no CESAR, nós temos algumas práticas que proporcionam uma rotina mais positiva para a pessoa colaboradora:

  • Estrutura horizontal

title: Técnico Ambiental
description:
Recrutamento Interno: Técnico Ambiental

Valorizamos nossos talentos e acreditamos em seu potencial

Para participar do processo, você precisa estar em sua posição atual há no mínimo 1 ano e também é necessário que sua liderança esteja ciente e de acordo com sua candidatura.

No momento do cadastro, coloque o e-mail do(a) gestor(a) no campo: "Indicador por" e avise-o(a) que será necessário validar a indicação para considerarmos sua participação

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Responsabilidades e atividades da vaga:

  • Realizar tarefas administrativas do setor (orçamentos, pedidos de compra, controle de notas fiscais referente a despesas com resíduos industriais) e controle de estoque da unidade.
  • Elaboração de documentos para a liberação dos resíduos (MTR – Manifesto de transporte de resíduos, Lista de verificação do veículo que efetua o transporte, Ficha / Envelope de emergência, Solicitação de nota fiscal), bem como toda a gestão operacional do tema, inspeção geral na planta industrial para atendimento das diretrizes de gerenciamento de resíduos, SGA.
  • Acompanhamento de melhorias e análise crítica do desempenha Ambiental do site
  • Elaboração e revisão de procedimentos operacionais do Sistema de Gestão Ambiental (ISO 14001)
  • Atuação nas unidades industriais do Grupo Eurofarma quanto aos temas relacionados ao Sistema de Gestão Ambiental, como requisitos legais, controle de qualificação prestadores de serviço, análise de não conformidades, avaliação ambiental de projetos, atualização de indicadores, etc.
  • Apoio em temas do SGA corporativos das unidades Brasil

Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Médio Completo e Curso Técnico
  • Domínio do Pacote Office
  • Conhecimentos do SAP
  • Experiência com sistemas de gestão ambiental ISO 14001, gestão de resíduos, efluentes.

Informações adicionais

Confira as diretrizes quanto a elegibilidade para o processo interno:

  • São elegíveis a participar deste processo colaboradores efetivos, estagiários e aprendizes;
  • Possuir os requisitos mínimos exigidos para a posição conforme a descrição de cargos vigente;
  • O colaborador só poderá se candidatar ao recrutamento interno caso a vaga seja de um cargo de nível igual ou superior ao que ocupa atualmente;
  • Não serão consideradas candidaturas para cargos acima de dois níveis da atual posição do colaborador (exemplo: Analista JR se candidatar para Analista SR);
  • O colaborador deverá ter o salário + adicionais* igual ou menor que o salário oferecido na vaga, desde que a movimentação não interfira no equilíbrio interno do cargo na área em que ele será aprovado. Esta análise é realizada pelas áreas de R&S e Remuneração;
  • Serão considerados para ao recrutamento interno de Analistas nível JR, apenas aqueles candidatos que possuam formação ou tenham sua formação de nível superior prevista para conclusão em até um ano da movimentação;
  • O colaborador não poderá concorrer em 2 ou mais processos simultaneamente;
  • O tempo mínimo para participar de um novo processo é de 6 meses para a mesma função (exceto nos casos de aproveitamento interno).

Validação do gestor:

  • A inscrição somente será aceita na plataforma Gupy. Durante o preenchimento do cadastro, deve -se inserir o e-mail do seu gestor(a) imediato no campo "indicado por" no momento em que se aplicar a vaga, onde esse receberá um e-mail diretamente da plataforma Gupy e deverá aprovar sua participação. Em caso de férias do gestor(a) imediato, o candidato(a) deve informar o email do gestor(a) responsável acima.

Local de Trabalho:

  • Horário: Adm Flex - 44h semanais

Com mais de 11 mil colaboradores, atuamos em todos os principais segmentos farmacêuticos e somos líderes em receituário médico no Brasil.

Sabemos do nosso importante papel de transformação na sociedade, entendendo que as pessoas são fundamentais na trajetória de crescimento, ao lado dos resultados, internacionalização, inovação e sustentabilidade, para nos tornarmos cada vez mais globais. Buscamos pluralidade de perfis, gêneros, raças, orientações e identidades, pois acreditamos que contribuições e percepções de pessoas distintas nos ajudam a encontrar, juntos, soluções novas e sustentáveis em saúde.

  • Elaborar, acompanhar e acompanhar indicadores de desempenho financeiro e contábil, bem como preparar demonstrações contábeis e relatórios relevantes para a gestão.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Formação superior em Contabilidade com CRC ativo.
  • Experiência comprovada com os softwares Mega da Senior ou Sienge (ERP) e forte atuação em implantação de ERP.
  • Sólidos conhecimentos contábeis, fiscais e tributários, com visão integrada de controles e compliance.
  • Capacidade de gerenciar um pequeno departamento contábil, com liderança, organização e foco em resultados.
  • Habilidade para atuar em ambiente de fase pré-operacional, com foco em implantação e melhoria de processos, seguido de atuação plena nas atividades de Contabilidade.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação em Rio de Janeiro, Ipanema (RJ).
