title: Dynamics 365 CE Senior Consultant
description:
Our client's Microsoft Business Solutions team is a Microsoft Gold Partner and leader in Microsoft software implementations for medium to large organisations, providing their clients with the ability to keep up with the ever-changing digital world by implementing Microsoft's Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and Customer Engagement (CE) software from the Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365) software line.

Role Overview

The Dynamics CRM Senior Consultant is a core team member of KPMG's customer delivery of Microsoft Dynamics 365 centred solutions. The Senior Consultant will be involved in the business processes and solution design and will be hands on configuring and customising the implementation of Dynamics CRM solutions working with both onshore and offshore development teams. The position may require business travel.

Job Location: Silema, Malta

Work Type: Hybrid

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

Working Hours: GMT +1

Salary: Base + Benefits (Paid in Euros €)

Relocation: VISA & Relocation Package Included

Requirements

  • A University graduate with relevant degree within a computing or business discipline
  • Microsoft D365 CE Certifications (2016, D365) are desirable
  • Strong functional knowledge and understanding of Microsoft D365 CE covering a wide spectrum of industries and sectors
  • At least 8+ years of hands-on proven functional experience in D365 CE configuration, standard workflows, dashboards, forms & views customizations, Report development
  • Detailed knowledge and understanding of all modules within D365 CE including Sales, Marketing, Customer Service & Field Services
  • Working knowledge of the Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI)
  • Good understanding of Dataverse including customisations and development of Business Data Models for different solutions
  • Good understanding of Microsoft Dynamics CRM Accelerators, industry templates and add-ons
  • A proven track record of successful implementation & maintenance of a number of solutions within large client companies, preferably across a number of business verticals (Healthcare, Education, Banking, Manufacturing etc.)
  • A proven ability to develop a clear understanding of clients' needs and the ability to incorporate them into a solution
  • Experience of consultancy roles in software delivery
  • Experience in a delivery-orientated IT environment using waterfall, agile and Devops methodologies
  • Adept at Business Requirement Analysis
  • The ability to see the greater picture and suggest solutions both within and outside the current implementation
  • Experience in supporting pre-sales activities is an advantage
  • Project documentation experience especially for work packages to be implemented by offshore teams
  • Business process mapping, modelling and documentation knowledge

Responsibilities

  • The senior consultant will work as a techno-functional lead to analyse, design, develop, test, maintain and support applications developed using D365 CE by working closely with client teams and business stakeholders.
  • Contribute to activities as required including building demo and proof of concept solutions for various client presentations
  • Work on the creation of Dynamics 365 solutions and industry templates
  • Meet and exceed customer expectations of business knowledge, skills and behaviour
  • Support practice & business development activities such as Pre-Sales, Recruitment, Mentoring Juniors, Sharing knowledge, Initiatives etc.
  • Ensure timely completion of internal processes and mandatory trainings
  • Carry out additional duties as may occur from time to time as instructed and agreed by the management team
  • Represent our client's Microsoft Business Solutions team in a professional and positive manner at all times
  • The Employee is required to follow our client's Information Security Policies (ISP and ISMP) at all times
  • Perform Project responsibilities as described and given below, towards Team (lead), Client (client facing) and Governance (aiding Project Managers)

Individual

  • Organise, manage and document workshops, meetings and requirements sessions with the client representatives, project stakeholders
  • Verifying customer requirements to ensure completeness and correctness by working with technical consultants/leads. Ask relevant and right questions to gather additional information to avoid confusion. Provide accurate estimations for tasks
  • Responsible involvement in low-level and high-level design; architecture/design of project; creation and elaboration of requirements/tasks to be given to technical leads/developers/team members; project documentation
  • Lay down quality guidelines (requirement traceability, acceptance criteria, non-functional requirements, other design standards etc.) for the project
  • Working closely with Technical Lead to setup quality gates and quality threshold parameters for project
  • Complete allocated tasks as per schedule with appropriate quality
  • Augment decision making for "inventing vs. re-using" knowledge/assets with appropriate reasoning. Get consensus from stakeholders and document decision for all project related decisions
  • Proactively raise and document concerns, risks, impediments pertaining to various aspects of project and provide support to mitigate them with appropriate RACI
  • Triage bugs, issues etc along with Technical lead during testing (System, UAT, Integration etc.)
  • Decision making with appropriate/relevant insights

Towards Team

  • Provide a clear definition for "Done"
  • Allocate work items/tasks to team members
  • Perform review of work done and provide necessary review comments to enforce quality
  • Provide required guidance and support to team members when stuck
  • Provide details to team on quality standards to be adhered
  • Setup and conduct daily stand-up meeting with team
  • Conduct monthly technical retrospective meetings with actionable outcomes.
  • Keep a check on everyone's understanding of end-goal
  • Involve appropriate team members for necessary decisions and take accountability of decisions
  • Advocate for feature reusability and efficiency gain

Towards Client

  • Participate in customer workshops as necessary
  • Provide guidance to customer and their IT/Business Analysts team
  • Provide sufficient reasoning for features that look "out of league"; Challenge the client on such requirements and suggest trade-offs as necessary
  • Provide clear weekly progress/status report for self and team
  • Highlight risks or impediments in appropriate forums

Towards Governance

  • Provide guidance and support in setup of Dev Management processes
  • Guidance in setting up right DevOps system & tools; Setup CI/CD pipeline with appropriate templates
  • Verification of Automate Build and release management (including Roll-back plans)
  • Setup and verification of right branching and merging strategy
  • Represent & provide opinions in management reviews or steering committee reviews
  • Ensure team calendar is up to date; Ensure appropriate work distribution, backup/backfill planning
  • Document Lessons Learnt and share it in broader forums
  • Provide immediate and appropriate feedback to team members

Microsoft Business Solutions Overview

At our client, your long-term future is every bit as important to them as it is to you. That's why our clients aim is to give you experiences that will stay with you for a lifetime. Whether it's great training and development, mobility opportunities or corporate responsibility volunteering activities – you'll gain a wealth of experiences on which to build a rewarding career. Our client is a firm that encourages you to be yourself, values your contribution, and inspires you to act as a role model, always focused on doing the right thing for each other, our clients, and our communities.

This sets out all the different ways you'll be rewarded at our client. Among other things, you can benefit from honest conversations about your career as well as a range of other rewards. In all these ways and more, they have created an environment that can bring out the best in you.

#Bethechange and #makethechange. Join our talented, successful team and make the leap into the future.

For this exciting opportunity they have put together a great package that combines a competitive salary with a bundle of extras including allowances, business travel allowances, certifications to support you in your career growth, private insurance, and medical insurance for you and your family.

Don't worry, our client knows that relocation can be a challenge, which is why they have an extremely supportive onboarding team to help you throughout this process - They provide relocation support for you and your family. Our client is looking forward to meeting you and seeing you grow.

E isso vai muito além de estilo: é sobre criar espaço para todas as vozes, todas as histórias, todos os sonhos. Acreditamos no poder da autenticidade, da coragem e da ambição. Desde 1978, carregamos no peito a paixão por moda acessível e a crença de que grandes histórias começam quando a gente se permite ir além. Evoluímos, crescemos, erramos, acertamos, mas seguimos inquietos. Porque aqui, inspiração move. E o cliente está sempre no centro de tudo.

Queremos mentes abertas, corações inteiros e atitudes que fazem a diferença.

Gente que transforma rotina em movimento, desafio em oportunidade e time em potência. Aqui, ambidestria é prática: sabemos equilibrar a operação com o sonho, a entrega com a criação, o hoje com o amanhã.

Somos feitos de ambição, mas também de respeito. Com verdade. Com afeto. Se você tem coragem pra fazer acontecer, fome de crescer e brilho nos olhos quando ouve a palavra transformação, esse também pode ser o seu lugar. Se seu sonho é grande, venha ser também.

title: Piloto de ROV
description:
Sobre a OceanPact
A OceanPact é uma empresa brasileira especializada em serviços marítimos, atuando com excelência nas áreas de meio ambiente, engenharia e logística offshore. Com presença sólida no mercado e atuação em todo o território nacional, oferecemos soluções integradas e sustentáveis para os desafios do mar.
Nosso propósito é transformar o cuidado com o mar em valor para todos.
Sobre a vaga
Estamos em busca de um(a) Piloto de ROV para atuar em operações submarinas, assegurando a execução com segurança das manutenções dos equipamentos de ROV, além de realizar pilotagem e suporte técnico às operações offshore. Essa posição é estratégica para garantir a eficiência operacional, a segurança dos envolvidos e a excelência em entregas subsea.
Responsabilidades
Executar manutenções preventivas e corretivas dos sistemas de ROV, conforme planejamento das operações.
Pilotar, lançar e recolher o ROV, assegurando segurança e qualidade nas operações.
Utilizar equipamentos auxiliares de navegação e operar manipuladores quando necessário.
Realizar pré e pós-dive, instalar/remover equipamentos e ferramentas de acordo com as demandas.
Preencher o dive log e registrar manutenções realizadas.
Gravar e editar imagens/áudios conforme necessidade dos projetos.
Distribuir tarefas e orientar trainees de ROV, garantindo execução segura e eficaz.
Participar ativamente de todas as atividades relacionadas à segurança e SMS.
Requisitos
Ensino médio concluído e formação técnica em eletrônica, mecânica, eletrotécnica ou mecatrônica (CFT ativo);
Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência comprovada em operações submarinas como piloto de ROV (RSV, AHTS, DSV ou PLSV);
Conhecimento em hidráulica ou elétrica;
Pacote Microsoft Office;
Conhecimento em sistemas de ROV Triton XLX, XLX EVO ou XLX-C;
Conhecimento em fibra óptica;
Conhecimento em LARS ODIM ou Dynacom;
Certificações atualizadas: CBSP, NR-10 e NR-35;
Local de trabalho
Modalidade: Embarcado – Bases offshore
Disponibilidade para embarques e regime offshore
O que buscamos
Queremos pessoas que se identifiquem com os nossos valores:
Dá pra fazer, com responsabilidade e qualidade
O jeito certo: ética, segurança e excelência
Gostamos do que fazemos: entusiasmo e envolvimento
Confiança: relações transparentes e comprometidas
Inovação: melhoria contínua e novas ideias
Resultados: foco em entregas com valor
O que oferecemos
Pacote de remuneração compatível com o mercado, com salário fixo e benefícios competitivos
Plano de saúde e odontológico, para você e sua família, porque cuidar de quem cuida importa
Vale-alimentação
Ambiente de trabalho colaborativo, seguro e ético, onde o cuidado com as pessoas e o mar são levados a sério
Oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento profissional, com participação em projetos relevantes, treinamentos e contato com equipes multidisciplinares
Cultura forte e propósito claro, em uma empresa brasileira sólida, que cresce com responsabilidade e inovação
Estabilidade e confiança, em uma organização que atua com excelência e compromisso no setor marítimo e offshore

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Main Purpose

This role provides exposure to a wide range of accounting, tax, and operational processes within the energy trading business, as well as opportunities to collaborate with other business units at an international level. The position requires strong technical expertise, analytical skills, and the ability to operate in a dynamic and multicultural environment.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or related fields; certified accountant is preferred.

  • Strong academic and technical background.

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in Accounting, Finance, Reporting and/or Tax areas, preferably in multinational companies or the energy/commodities sector.

  • Previous experience in a Big 4 accounting firm is a plus.

  • Solid knowledge of Brazilian tax and accounting regulations; familiarity with IFRS standards.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills with proven ability to operate in international and multicultural contexts.

  • Advanced to fluent English; Spanish is considered a strong asset.

  • Proficiency in Excel and ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, or similar).

  • Operational, tax and regulatory knowledge of the free energy market is a plus

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee tax and accounting processes, review of direct/indirect taxes, statutory reporting, and compliance with local and international standards.

  • Revise accounting entries, GL reconciliations and intercompany reporting.

  • Support monthly and annual closings, as well as external and internal audits.

  • Ensure accurate accounting of contracts, financing, intercompany/intracompany transactions, and projects.

  • Maintain and monitor fixed asset registers, ensuring compliance with corporate depreciation and accounting policies.

  • Support local and international teams (accounting, procurement, tax, treasury, legal, and operations) to ensure alignment across business units.

  • Monitor and interpret regulatory and tax changes, assessing their impact on the energy trading business.

  • Support back-office operations in the energy market, including registration and settlement processes with the relevant regulatory entities.

title: Engenheiro de Segurança do Trabalho
description:
REQUISITOS MANDATÓRIOS

EXPERIÊNCIA

  • Profundo conhecimento das Normas Regulamentadoras do Ministério do Trabalho.
  • Experiência com PGR, LTCAT, laudos e programas de SST.

  • Domínio de análise de riscos, estatísticas de acidentes, investigação e medidas de controle.
  • Conhecimento em planejamento estratégico, gestão de metas e indicadores.
  • Leitura e interpretação de normas técnicas (ABNT, ISO) aplicáveis à segurança.
  • Experiência prévia na área de saúde e segurança ocupacional.

ESCOLARIDADE

  • Nível de Formação: Engenharia com pós-graduação em Engenharia de Segurança do Trabalho.

  • Inglês intermediário.

  • Comunicação clara e influência.
  • Capacidade de negociação e tomada de decisão.
  • Organização, disciplina e foco em resultados.
  • Atuação colaborativa com áreas multidisciplinares.
  • Experiência em ambientes industriais, logísticos ou de operações de médio e grande porte

ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Desenvolver, implementar e atualizar o PGR – Programa de Gerenciamento de Riscos, com base na NR-01, garantindo análise de perigos, avaliação de riscos e definição de medidas de controle.
  • Supervisionar e elaborar documentos técnicos como LTCAT – Laudo Técnico das Condições Ambientais de Trabalho, assegurando atendimento às exigências previdenciárias.
  • Apoiar a elaboração e revisão de demais programas e laudos ambientais, conforme requisitos legais e necessidades da empresa.
  • Assegurar a aderência às Normas Regulamentadoras (NRs) vigentes, especialmente aquelas relacionadas à saúde e segurança ocupacional.
  • Acompanhar atualizações legais, orientar gestores e promover ações corretivas e preventivas para garantir conformidade.
  • Coordenar e orientar treinamentos previstos em NRs aplicáveis, garantindo registros, periodicidade e documentação.
  • Planejar e executar auditorias internas de segurança, avaliando processos, procedimentos, documentos e práticas operacionais.
  • Identificar não conformidades, oportunidades de melhoria e riscos críticos, desenvolvendo planos de ação com áreas responsáveis.
  • Monitorar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) relacionados à saúde e segurança, fornecendo relatórios para alta liderança.
  • Fornecer análises técnicas para investigação de acidentes e incidentes, elaborando relatórios e propondo medidas preventivas.
  • Acompanhar atividades críticas, inspeções de campo, análises preliminares de risco (APR) e permissões de trabalho.
  • Atuar como referência técnica para gestores e equipes operacionais.
  • Participar do processo de planejamento estratégico da empresa, garantindo que metas e ações de segurança estejam alinhadas aos objetivos corporativos.
  • Propor iniciativas de melhoria contínua, investimentos e projetos relacionados à redução de riscos e promoção de ambiente seguro.
  • Garantir a integração de gestão de segurança com normas e boas práticas do mercado, como a ISO 45001.
  • Elaborar planejamento para certificação do Sistema de Gestão.

Na Capco promovemos uma cultura inclusiva. Valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas expressões. 
Pensamos, em conjunto, sempre em ações diversas de inclusão e de responsabilidade social através de comitês internos geridos pela nossa comunidade interna, como os grupo de Mulheres, Pessoas Com Deficiência, Pessoas Negras, LGBTQIAPN+, Parentalidade, Gerações, entre outros.

title: Retention Marketing Specialist
description:
UN/COMMON is a digital experience and marketing agency that launches and grows the world's best emerging brands. We believe the future of consumer-facing brands starts with creating authentic stories built for the consumer first and brand second. We are extremely proud to work with revolutionary brands such as Selena Gomez's Rare Beauty, Dermalogica, Liquid Death, Lemon Perfect, and more.

We are an employee and customer-centric agency bringing mission first brand stories to life to benefit the greater good and better people's lives. And we have a TON of fun doing it

The Retention Marketing Specialist owns the day-to-day execution of email and SMS production for our clients. This includes project management, content planning, copy and creative briefs, HTML builds, QA, and scheduling. You will manage end-to-end production and keep timelines on track across design, strategy, and client teams. You will work closely with a Retention Marketing Strategist to support retention strategy, reporting, and ongoing optimization. If you enjoy organized workflows, sharp deadlines, clean builds, and improving the customer journey through thoughtful messaging, you will do well here.

What You Will Do

You will manage the full production process for email campaigns and automated flows, build emails in Klaviyo or similar ESPs, write on-brand copy, create clear briefs for the design team, QA content and logic, and schedule deployments. You will maintain the monthly content calendar, drive timelines with clients, and ensure all assets and approvals stay on track. You will support the Retention Marketing Strategist by pulling performance data, analyzing results, and developing recommendations. You will build automated workflows, segmentation, and list logic, maintain list hygiene, and work confidently with Shopify apps such as Yotpo, Loyalty Lion, JustUno, and Privy.

Based on our projected customer base growth, we foresee the need for a  Retention Marketing Specialist  within the next 2-4 months to ensure we can effectively manage and nurture our expanding user community.

Requirements

What You Need

  • 2 years of experience in retention marketing, specifically across email, SMS, CRM, or loyalty programs.
  • Hands-on experience with an Email Service Platform (ESP), with a strong preference for Klaviyo.
  • Strong copywriting skills for direct-to-consumer (DTC) e-commerce, with the ability to adapt tone and style to match different client brands.
  • A solid understanding of email analytics and the ability to translate data insights into actionable strategy.
  • Clear understanding of the difference between marketing campaigns and automated flows, and knowing when to deploy each.
  • Proficiency in building segmented customer lists using behavioral and transactional data.
  • Experience working within Shopify or directly supporting Shopify-based clients.
  • A proactive, organized approach, with the ability to think through the entire customer journey and work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative team.

What Success Looks Like

Your production process is smooth, predictable, and organized. Clients trust your communication and follow your timelines. Email and SMS performance improves because of your quality and attention to detail. Strategy and reporting move faster because you stay ahead of data and execution. You keep projects aligned, informed, and on schedule. You take ownership, ask smart questions, and keep work moving forward.

Benefits

This is a contract position
Up to 40 hours weekly
Remote
Selection Process

The selection process includes a video interview screening, followed by role-specific discussions (possible assessment) and a final leadership conversation.

Commitment to Inclusion

UN/COMMON is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all employees can thrive and bring their full selves to work.

About UN/COMMON

UN/COMMON has been recognized by Inc. Magazine as one of the fastest-growing private companies in America, reflecting our people-driven approach to growth, innovation, and excellence.

Agency Policy

Recruiting agencies are not authorized to submit candidates for this role. UN/COMMON does not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate submissions from agencies.

Objective of the role
The Finance Analyst will play a key role in supporting the analysis and structuring of financing transactions, assessing market rates, debt and equity alternatives, and applying advanced financial models. The position is expected to contribute to the design of financial strategies aligned with corporate goals, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and high-quality decision-making.

Main Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain financial models for corporate and project transactions, including the use of financing Model A.

  • Conduct market rate analysis and evaluate its effect on projects and financing structures.
  • Assess financing options (debt and equity), supporting the structuring and negotiation of alternatives.
  • Support capital raising processes (debt and equity), including the preparation of financial materials, participation in due diligence, and interaction with investors and financial institutions.
  • Prepare and contribute to capital presentations for investors, the board of directors, and other key stakeholders.
  • Coordinate with internal departments (technical, legal, commercial) and external advisors to ensure timely and accurate information flow.
  • Conduct market and risk analysis to support investment and financing decisions.
  • Prepare financial reports, presentations, and executive summaries for management, investors, and other relevant audiences.
Requirements
  • University degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Civil Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in financial analysis, ideally in investment banking, M&A, and/or debt financing.
  • Advanced skills in financial modelling and analytical tools.
  • Fluency in English and Portugues (mandatory).
  • Spanish is a plus
  • Proactive, versatile, and curious profile with strong interpersonal and teamwork skills.
  • Commitment to sustainability and diversity values.
  • Flexibility and adaptability to take on new tasks according to business needs.

Os (as) Arquitetos (as) de Solução da Oracle fazem a conexão entre negócios e tecnologia para nossos clientes, criando soluções de valor. 

Combinando com um profundo conhecimento de tecnologia, aplicativos, melhores práticas do Business, processos de negócios e padrões de arquitetura para impulsionar iniciativas de transformação de TI que atendam aos objetivos de negócios de nossos clientes e que transmitam as mensagens para nossos clientes desde o público técnico quanto para o público Executivo C-Level.

O entendimento dos diferentes cenários, a ênfase nos benefícios aos negócios, bem como levantamento e apresentação de casos de referências serão algumas das atividades principais da função. Internamente precisará trabalhar no alinhamento de conceitos, engajamento de recursos e profissionais, para, ao final apresentar uma proposta completa e aderente ao negócio do cliente.

Trabalhar com atitude proativa, comprometimento e engajamento são as principais características que buscamos nas pessoas.

Como arquiteto (a) de soluções, você tem a chance de se desenvolver em um espectro muito amplo, desde expertise em produtos, interação com clientes, comunicação, conhecimento em diversas áreas de negócios de nossos clientes e conhecimento geral do mercado de TI.

A pessoa desta vaga precisa ter paixão por oferecer soluções de impacto positivo aos clientes, através da construção de relacionamentos duradouros e de excelência. Tudo isso, dentro de um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico, sem uma rotina fixa e com foco na construção de confiança entre todas as partes envolvidas.

Responsibilities

RESPONSABILIDADES


• Definir arquiteturas e propostas de soluções, utilizando técnicas de criação de valor ao negócio do cliente;


• Apresentar e articular recursos e benefícios da solução de tecnologia Oracle para a clientes em potencial;


• Colaborar com outras equipes de pré-vendas para gerar resultados de negócios, aumentar as taxas de ganhos e melhores propostas para o cliente;


• Manter conhecimento atualizado e relevante de soluções competitivas e estratégias vencedoras;


• Criar e entregar apresentações, demonstrações personalizadas, seminários, workshops além de conduzir e demonstrar casos de uso com as soluções da Oracle para nossos clientes;


• Desenvolver parcerias sólidas com os clientes cultivando um relacionamento de confiança com foco na construção de uma percepção de valor positiva por parte do cliente;


• Envolver-se com os clientes traduzindo suas necessidades de negócios em soluções apropriadas;


• Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com os clientes para identificar soluções que enderecem desafios de negócios;


• A pessoa trabalhará com tecnologias em rápida evolução, componentes no local/nuvem para definir soluções exclusivas.

HABILIDADES NECESSÁRIAS

  • Experiência como pré-vendas e/ou arquiteto de soluções;
  • Sólido conhecimento em licitações RFPs/RFIs, preferencialmente com alguma experiência atendendo a grandes contas. 
  • Conhecimento de Arquitetura em nuvens públicas;
  • Experiência prática no planejamento, desenvolvimento e entrega de projetos de migração de nuvem para nuvem (desejável on-premise para nuvem também);
  • Desenvolvimento de arquiteturas Cloud prioritariamente, de Data Center e Soluções em infraestrutura física (Hosting);

  • Conhecimentos em tecnologias de infraestrutura como banco de dados, middleware, aplicativos e hardware;
  • Soluções de replicação em ambiente físico e/ou nuvem e conceitos sobre RTO/RPO/DR
  • Experiência com relacionamento com o cliente;
  • Experiência em Multi-Cloud e Infraestrutura de TI tradicional;

HABILIDADES DESEJÁVEIS

  • Formação superior na área de tecnologia ou cursos relacionados;
  • Forte compreensão de desenvolvimento de sistemas utilizando estruturas Cloud Native, tradicionais monolíticas e sistemas distribuídos;

Elaborar, revisar e validar pareceres, estudos e memorandos fiscais, com caráter preventivo, consultivo e estratégico.

Garantir a escrituração fiscal tempestiva, identificando e corrigindo desvios quando houver intempestividade.
Garantir o recolhimento de todos os tributos no prazo.
Atuar na revisão do compliance de tributos diretos e indiretos, com ênfase em IRPJ, CSLL, PIS e COFINS
Acompanhar, interpretar e disseminar atualizações da legislação tributária municipal, estadual e federal.
Atualizar e monitorar de forma contínua a Matriz de Riscos Tributários.
Mapear oportunidades fiscais e identificar, avaliar e mitigar riscos tributários para otimização dos processos.
Monitorar os impactos da Reforma Tributária, avaliando riscos, oportunidades e efeitos nos modelos de negócio atuais e futuros.
Apoiar no controle, solicitação, manutenção e renovação de regimes especiais.
Gerir e acompanhar incentivos fiscais aplicáveis às operações.
Acompanhar e atender fiscalizações, auditorias e demandas de órgãos fiscalizadores, fornecendo informações, apoio técnico e interface com consultorias externas e autoridades fiscais.
Atuar de forma integrada com Controladoria, Contabilidade, Jurídico, Financeiro e Projetos, promovendo alinhamento e antecipação de riscos.
Suportar a estruturação fiscal de novos contratos, operações e projetos — especialmente no setor de energias renováveis (geração, comercialização de energia, incentivos regionais etc.).
Gerenciar, desenvolver e capacitar a equipe fiscal, promovendo atualização técnica contínua e boas práticas.
Criar, revisar e atualizar procedimentos da área.

title: Bio Ritmo
description:
Endereço
Avenida Pepe, 1360, Barra da Tijuca - Rio de Janeiro, RJ

Como é o ambiente de trabalho?
Nos esforçamos para manter um ambiente descontraído, onde a opinião de todos reflete nas decisões da equipe. Trabalhamos de forma colaborativa e criativa. Estamos em constante evolução e sempre abertos a novas tendências.

Responsabilidades da Oportunidade

O Grupo Smart Fit é um dos maiores ecossistemas de fitness e um dos grupos que mais crescem no mundo. Empresa brasileira, fundada por Edgard Corona, iniciou sua história em 1996 com a Bio Ritmo, levando saúde, movimento e qualidade de vida por meio de uma experiência diferenciada de atividade física.

Essa trajetória ganhou escala com a criação da Smart Fit, marca que transformou o mercado ao democratizar o acesso ao fitness de alto padrão, tornando a prática de atividade física mais acessível e presente na vida de milhões de pessoas. A partir daí, o Grupo manteve um crescimento consistente, expandindo sua atuação e diversificando seu portfólio para atender diferentes perfis, objetivos e momentos da jornada das pessoas.

Hoje, o Grupo Smart Fit está presente em mais de 16 países, conta com mais de 2.000 unidades e opera um ecossistema completo de marcas que inclui academias como Smart Fit, Bio Ritmo e Nation CT; a BEON Studios, que conecta estúdios especializados em uma rede única: Race Bootcamp, Vidya Studio, Jab House, Tonus Gym, Aera Pilates, Velocity e Kore, além dos produtos digitais TotalPass e Queima Diária. Juntas, essas marcas criam experiências físicas e digitais que ampliam o acesso ao bem-estar, com praticidade, inovação e parcerias estratégicas.

Marcas do Grupo Smart Fit:

Smart Fit: A 3 maior rede de academias próprias do mundo, com acesso democrático, tecnologia e estrutura completa.

Bio Ritmo: Academia premium com treinos personalizados, equipamentos de ponta e experiência de alto padrão.

Nation CT: Mais que um centro de alta performance, uma experiência única dentro de uma infraestrutura completa e moderna. Foco em performance e comunidade.

A BEON Studios um ecossistema highend de studios que reúne múltiplas experiências de bem-estar e treinos coletivos, com inovação e excelência para nossos alunos e franqueados

Quais são os nossos estúdios?

Race Bootcamp: Treinos intervalados em esteira e musculação, com alta intensidade e experiência imersiva.

Vidya Studio: Estúdio de yoga contemporâneo, com práticas que combinam bem-estar, equilíbrio e conexão mente-corpo.

Jab House: Aulas de boxe fitness com música, luzes e dinâmica de alto gasto calórico.

Tonus Gym: Treinos focados em resistência e fortalecimento muscular com ênfase em resultados rápidos e medidos.

Kore: Studio de core training com treinos focados em estabilidade, força central e corpo inteiro.

Velocity: Aulas de bike indoor no formato boutique, com experiência sensorial e estímulo total.

Aera Pilates: Pilates contemporâneo com equipamentos modernos e treinos que unem força, consciência corporal e mobilidade.

Produtos Digitais

Queima Diária: Plataforma de treinos online com programas variados para todos os níveis e objetivos.

TotalPass: Benefício corporativo de bem-estar que dá acesso a milhares de academias, estúdios e serviços de saúde.

Você fará parte do Grupo Smart Fit, a 3 maior rede de academias próprias do mundo.Esta vaga é para atuar na Bio Ritmo, marca premium do grupo, que oferece uma experiência de treino completa, com ambientes sofisticados, serviços exclusivos e foco em performance, bem-estar e resultados

Como Estagiário(a) de Musculação da Bio Ritmo você irá:

  • Apoiar os(as) professores(as) na preparação e condução de aulas, treinamentos e atividades físicas;
  • Auxiliar os(as) alunos(as) com orientações sobre exercícios, uso adequado de equipamentos e práticas seguras;
  • Organizar e preparar os espaços para a realização de aulas e atividades, garantir a segurança e a funcionalidade dos ambientes;
  • Promover hábitos saudáveis e bem-estar, incentivar a prática regular de atividades físicas e a adoção de um estilo de vida saudável;
  • Realizar as formações dos programas de musculação;
  • Participar de encontros técnicos, reuniões da unidade e treinamentos.

Requisitos
O que esperamos de você:

  • Estar cursando a partir do 5 semestre - Bacharel em Educação Física
  • Proativo;
  • Comprometido;
  • Boa comunicação.

Benefícios

  • Academia / Práticas Esportivas
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Universidade Corporativa
  • Vale-Transporte

Sobre a Organização
O Grupo Smart Fit detém as marcas de academia full service Smart Fit & Bio Ritmo, as marcas de academias estúdio Race Bootcamp, Vidya Body & Mind, Tonus Muscle Lab, Jab House e Nós, além dos produtos digitais Total Pass e Queima Diária.

Juntas, nossas marcas possuem mais de 800 unidades e mais de 2,5 milhões de clientes ativos. Estamos presente no Brasil, México, Chile, Peru, Colômbia, República Dominicana, Equador, Argentina, Panamá, Guatemala, Paraguai, El Salvador e Honduras.

Somos a maior empresa no segmento de fitness da América Latina e a terceira maior do mundo.

title: Senior Legal Counsel (Chemicals and Retail)- Relocate to Saudi Arabia

Senior Legal Counsel (Chemicals and Retail) - Relocate to Saudi Arabia

Join to apply for the Senior Legal Counsel (Chemicals and Retail) - Relocate to Saudi Arabia role at ARAMCO .

Candidate must relocate to Saudi Arabia.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world and a top global company by market capitalization.

Overview

We are seeking an experienced attorney to join the Chemicals & Retail Legal Practice of the Downstream Law Department within the Aramco Law Organization.

The Practice provides legal support to many downstream entities, primarily from a shareholder and governance perspective, with a focus on general corporate and commercial contracts.

As Counsel, your primary role is to provide legal advice to Saudi Aramco and its subsidiaries, particularly in the area of commercial agreements for the supply and offtake of Saudi Aramco’s wide array of products, including long‑term crude and product sales/placements, crude importation, long‑term refined product/chemical offtakes, processing/netting agreements, tolling arrangements and international hydrocarbon trading.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the corporate secretary for one or more entities, organizing and managing board meetings, and advising as to board authority and corporate governance matters.
  • Advise as to shareholder issues and manage the interface between the entity, the parent, and other affiliates.
  • Work closely with internal Saudi Aramco Downstream clients and support their substantial and complex contracting and purchasing functions.
  • Draft, review, and negotiate contracts, O&M agreements, service agreements, and other commercial contracts and related agreements, including complex products supply and offtake agreements.
  • Advise on internal policies, review and resolve claims, and provide training to company personnel on a variety of legal matters.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor of Law degree minimum; Master or Juris degree preferred.
  • Current admission to general practice before the highest court of the state or country of which you are a citizen or resident.
  • A minimum of 7 years progressive experience gained in a sophisticated law firm or corporation. A mix of private practice and in‑house experience would be preferred.
  • Relevant commercial contracts and general corporate experience, particularly in the downstream chemicals and retail sectors.
  • Excellent negotiation and communication skills.
  • Experience providing concise and clear support to clients and leadership, and mentorship experience.

description:
Job Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”), which for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Commercial & Marketing

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Position Overview

The Head of Brand & Marketing at FWWC27 LTDA, which is FIFA’s Brazilian subsidiary responsible for the delivery of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Brazil (TM), will be tasked to guide and implement brand and marketing plans, campaigns and activations in line with the marketing & communication strategy. This role is critical to the success of the first ever FIFA Women’s World Cup to be held in South America with a vision to unite the world through an unprecedented experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as an extension to, and be part of the global MBBI (Marketing, Brand, Business Intelligence) team based in Zurich with dual reporting lines, for being a key representative to all Brand, Marketing and Promotion Tournament matters.
  • Responsible for all promotional aspects including any communications designed and required to support the commercial and marketing objectives of the tournament.
  • Be the main liaison for Host Country and Host City representatives, tournament executive leadership representing the MBBI team.
  • Lead the local, regional and national delivery of various marketing campaigns and initiatives related to, and beyond identified tournament milestones.
  • Lead a team of brand & marketing professionals on the ground, and ensure seamless cooperation, collaboration and integration with all relevant functional areas at FWWC27 LTDA and FIFA’s head office in Zurich, as well as any other functional areas such as legal, finance, etc.
  • Identify and communicate opportunities to create dedicated local, regional or national promotional activities that support the objectives of the tournament, the marketing strategy, or any relevant stakeholders such as commercial partners, media partners, host cities, and others.
  • Identify and drive commercial value through the marketing of the tournament’s brand assets and intellectual property, including but not limited to mascots, licensing & retail, the FIFA Fan Festival, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Trophy Tour, official music tracks/album/sonic identities, and other.
  • Contribute to, and drive implementation of ticketing & hospitality go-to-market strategy and activations plans.
  • Establish and maintain strong and impactful relationships with relevant partners, celebrities, influencers, key event organizers, agencies, etc.
  • Manage and maintain budget and liaise with the relevant colleagues in Zurich in all matters budget and spend.
  • Oversee the correct implementation and utilization of all in-market tournament brand asset implementations and applications including, but not limited to, event and stadium dressing, experiential marketing applications, retail branding, and any other use of the brand assets by FIFA’s internal and external stakeholders.
  • Manage procurement and legal processes (in compliance with FWWC27 LTDA policies and guidelines) as it relates to the tendering and contracting of local, regional or national suppliers, service providers, agencies, and other.
  • Manage and deliver all necessary reporting measures related to the tournament.
  • Drive and manage effective communications between the relevant functional areas and, in particular with the MBBI team in Zurich.

Your Profile

  • Bachelor’s degree or similar higher education in marketing, or a marketing related discipline.
  • Minimum 10 years’ experience in a relevant leadership position.
  • Proven experience delivering major brand & marketing plans.
  • Experience in the sports and/or entertainment industry is a major plus.
  • Experience working in a global or international environment.
  • Proven track record in managing a team in a matrix or similar structure.
  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills and the ability to manage up, down and sideways.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills.
  • Profound knowledge of Brazilian and South American markets and culture.
  • Ability to work to deadlines and stress resilient.
  • Financial and budget management.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Sustaining Engineering is a business critical team that continuously improves various open source software by resolving software defects reported by customers. This position leads one of our regional teams and is one of several managers, who report directly to the global Director of Sustaining Engineering.
Our customers build large-scale mission critical infrastructure and application solutions on Ubuntu and open source from Canonical. While not actively developing products, Sustaining Engineering, as part of Support Engineering, solves problems for the customer and for the benefit of the wider Open Source community. This team is well staffed with experts in every time zone and, while the work can be challenging sometimes, the team is resourced to ensure a good work-life balance and ongoing development of each team member.
As an engineering manager in the Sustaining Engineering team, your primary responsibility is to the people you support: ensuring that they are growing as engineers, making valuable contributions, and generally having a great experience at Canonical. Technical leadership and a solid background in software development are a must, so that you are able to help your team members grow professionally. description:
Overview

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will participate in the Neurodegeneration Computational Fellows Training Program (NDCF) at Howard University, developing and applying computational skills in neuroscience research. Under the mentorship of host labs, the fellow will contribute to analyzing datasets related to neurodegenerative diseases, such as Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s, or traumatic brain injury (TBI), advancing the understanding of disease mechanisms. This role supports the program’s mission to train researchers in advanced mathematics, data analysis, and bioinformatics for neurodegeneration research.

Supervisory Authority

This position has no supervisory authority. The fellow will work directly under the supervision of a principal investigator or mentor in a host lab affiliated with the NDCF program, receiving guidance on research tasks and computational training.

Nature And Scope

The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will engage in interdisciplinary research within a host lab at Howard University or a partner institution, such as NIH/NINDS, focusing on computational approaches to neurodegeneration. The fellow will gain hands-on experience analyzing neurophysiological, genomic, or imaging data using tools like Python, R, or machine learning frameworks. The fellow will collaborate with researchers, other fellows, and faculty, participating in lab meetings and NDCF symposia. The role is designed to support professional growth by developing skills in data analysis and contributing to research publications. External opportunities may include presenting at conferences or collaborating with partners in the Neurodegeneration Challenge Network (NDCN) under the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Assist in analyzing datasets (e.g., MRI, genomic, or microbiome data) using computational tools under the guidance of a mentor, identifying patterns or biomarkers in neurodegenerative diseases.
  • Learn and apply statistical or machine learning methods to support research on disease mechanisms, following lab protocols.
  • Support data processing tasks, such as image analysis or sequence alignment, using provided software or scripts.
  • Prepare research summaries and present findings at NDCF symposia, lab meetings, or external conferences.
  • Contribute to team discussions, collaborating with lab members to integrate computational and experimental findings.
  • Maintain accurate records of research activities and adhere to ethical standards in data handling and reporting.

Core Competencies

  • Computational Aptitude: Basic familiarity with programming (e.g., Python, R) or data analysis tools, with a strong interest in learning advanced computational techniques.
  • Analytical Thinking: Ability to approach complex datasets with curiosity and apply structured methods to derive meaningful insights under mentorship.
  • Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills to work effectively in interdisciplinary teams, including researchers, students, and faculty.
  • Communication: Clear written and verbal communication to present research progress and engage with scientific audiences.
  • Adaptability: Eagerness to acquire new skills and adapt to evolving research tools and methodologies in a training-focused environment.

Minimum Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in neuroscience, biology, computer science, bioinformatics, or a related field.
  • Experience: Some exposure to programming, data analysis, or neuroscience research through coursework, internships, or personal projects. No prior expertise required.
  • Skills: Basic familiarity with computational tools (e.g., Python, R, MATLAB, or command-line interfaces) or a strong interest in learning these skills. Introductory knowledge of statistics or data visualization is a plus.
  • Other: Demonstrated interest in neurodegeneration research and the ability to work collaboratively under mentorship guidance.

title: Funcionários da Faetec passam a receber vale-alimentação
description:
Funcionários da Faetec passam a receber vale-alimentação

A Fundação de Apoio à Escola Técnica (Faetec), vinculada à Secretaria de Estado de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação, iniciou nesta quinta-feira (26) a distribuição do vale-alimentação a todos os funcionários da Rede. A partir de agora, servidores de carreira e de contratos temporários podem contar com um cartão com valor mensal que pode chegar a R$660,00.
Os funcionários com carga horária de 20h semanais irão receber o valor mensal de R$330,00. Para os profissionais que trabalham 40h e 60h será depositado a quantia de R$660,00. O cartão poderá ser utilizado em estabelecimentos parceiros e já está sendo distribuído a todos os 5.162 funcionários, que atuam em mais de 120 unidades da Rede, em 63 municípios do Estado.
Além da Presidente da Faetec, Caroline Alves, o Secretário de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação, Mauro Azevedo Neto, esteve presente na entrega do primeiro vale-alimentação a um servidor da Rede. Ele acredita que o benefício chega para reconhecer os esforços do servidor.
“Sempre que tínhamos reuniões, a Carol trazia essa pauta como valorização do servidor, então é um prazer estar aqui no momento dessa entrega. Sou filho de professora da rede estadual de educação e sei como os auxílios aos servidores e a valorização do servidor são importantes. Na secretaria já fui assistente, assessor, chefe de gabinete, subsecretário e hoje estou como secretário, então sei que são os servidores que constroem a secretaria e a Faetec. O governador está sendo um parceiro nas pautas de educação, a gente sabe que o orçamento é curto, mas sempre que valoriza o servidor, ele é bem gasto”, declarou o S ecretário.
Os servidores e temporários recebem o vale-alimentação com o benefício referente aos meses de setembro e outubro. A medida não só reconhece e valoriza os profissionais que atuam nas unidades da Faetec, mas contribui para um ambiente de trabalho mais saudável e motivador.
Para Caroline Alves, presidente da Faetec, a entrega do vale-alimentação só foi possível graças ao empenho dos próprios funcionários, que se dedicam diariamente para que a Faetec continue sendo uma instituição de excelência. A gestora aproveitou a ocasião para agradecer a parceria da Secretaria.
“Essa é uma causa dos servidores de muitos anos e é uma construção que estamos fazendo juntos, sempre tenho esse cuidado de ouvir o outro, dialogar e construir isso junto. Eu acredito que essa entrega é importante para a nossa Rede e não posso deixar de mencionar o secretário que nos ajudou, abriu caminhos e deu suporte nessa construção”, concluiu a presidente da Faetec.

Andi Case

Quem somos?

Smart Hospital: Transformando a saúde com inovação. Somos líderes em construção, reforma e operação de infraestrutura hospitalar, pioneiros em modernizar hospitais por meio de parcerias público-privadas. Em parceria com o Complexo Hospitalar Souza Aguiar, o maior hospital de emergência da América Latina, estamos redefinindo os padrões de atendimento em saúde.

O que buscamos?

Um profissional que consiga ser um gestor de projetos eficaz, garantindo que a obra:

  • Seja segura e legal.
  • Seja concluída dentro do orçamento e do prazo.
  • Minimize o transtorno causado pela obra.

As principais funções do síndico no contexto de obras são:

  • Garantir a Segurança e a Conformidade Legal
    Exigir o cumprimento da NBR 16.280 e do regimento interno do condomínio em todas as reformas, seja nas áreas comuns ou nas unidades privativas.
    Zelar pela conservação e segurança da edificação (Art. 1.348, V, do Código Civil), responsabilizando‑se por qualquer dano causado por negligência na fiscalização.
  • Autorizações e Documentação
    Analisar e aprovar o Plano de Reforma detalhado antes de qualquer obra ser iniciada.
    Exigir a Anotação de Responsabilidade Técnica (ART) ou o Registro de Responsabilidade Técnica (RRT), assinados por engenheiro ou arquiteto habilitado, garantindo que um profissional seja o responsável técnico pela obra.
    Manter a documentação da obra arquivada.

Requisitos

  • I. Requisitos Técnicos e Legais
    • Conhecimento da NBR 16.280: É obrigatório que o síndico conheça a fundo a norma que trata da Gestão de Reformas em Edificações.
    • Noções Básicas de Construção Civil: capacidade de ler e interpretar plantas simples, entender orçamentos, cronogramas e etapas.
    • Domínio do Código Civil (Obras): conhecer os quóruns de aprovação de obras (Artigos 1.341 a 1.343).
    • Habilidade em Análise de Documentos: analisar e arquivar corretamente ARTs, RRTs, laudos de inspeção, contratos e garantias.
    • Gestão de Contratos: conhecer aspectos essenciais de contratos de empreitada/serviço.
  • II. Requisitos de Gestão e Administrativos
    • Organização e Método: gerar e controlar documentação, orçamentos e cronogramas.
    • Rigor Financeiro: elaborar previsões orçamentárias detalhadas e controlar desembolsos.
    • Planejamento Estratégico: priorizar obras de manutenção preventiva e planejar projetos de longo prazo.
    • Transparência: garantir clareza na seleção de fornecedores e prestação de contas.
  • III. Requisitos Comportamentais (Perfil)
    • Liderança e Proatividade: contratar consultorias, realizar cotações e manter preventivas.
    • Capacidade de Comunicação: informar moradores sobre impacto e dialogar com empreiteira.
    • Negociação e Imparcialidade: negociar contratos e prazos, mediar conflitos entre vizinhos.
    • Resolução de Problemas (Crise): lidar com atrasos, problemas estruturais e acidentes.

Benefícios

  • Day Off no Aniversário.
  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico.
  • Seguro de Vida.
  • Totalpass.
  • Vale Transporte.
  • Vale Refeição.

title: Software Engineering Manager (Backend SaaS)
description:
Software Engineering Manager (Backend SaaS)

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors.

We are hiring an engineering manager to lead the reboot of our Landscape systems management solution for Ubuntu. Ubuntu is growing rapidly in the enterprise, with estates expanding from cloud, to bare metal servers, to vSphere clusters, and of course desktops and devices. Landscape helps manage policy, compliance, patch management, and access control across large estates.

We have a system that serves thousands of deployments, and we want to give it a fresh vision. This role is the critical engineering leadership role for that mission.

Engineering managers at Canonical bring both technical and management skills. You will work closely with product managers and produce an engineering roadmap with ambitious and achievable goals. You will grow a team of engineers, collaborate with other engineering and business teams, and provide periodic updates about successes and areas of improvement.

As an engineering manager you must be technically strong, but your responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage, helping them grow as engineers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and lead a team of engineers in your region
  • Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback, and hands‑on career development
  • Demonstrate sound engineering principles and directly contribute toward your team's goals
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, management, and external stakeholders
  • Lead modern, agile software development practices
  • Ensure a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organization
  • Build automated, highly reliable image delivery, testing and publication pipelines
  • Engage with many other teams at Canonical, as well as the open‑source community and commercial partners
  • Work from home with global travel 4–6 weeks per year for internal and external events

Valued Skills and Experience

  • You love to mentor, develop and grow people, and have a track record of doing it
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • You are focused on success and the delivery of timely, high‑quality software
  • You have experience and commitment to agile development methodologies
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent degree in Computer Science, STEM or similar
  • Software development experience in Python or Golang
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Practical experience with Linux system administration

What We Offer

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Canonical is an equal‑opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Software Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Linux Kernel
description:
Software Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Linux Kernel

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Linux Kernel role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open‑source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT.

Our customers include the world’s leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring Software Engineering Managers to lead technical teams in the various aspects of the delivery and ongoing support and maintenance of all Linux kernels provided by the Ubuntu Linux distribution. As the Linux kernel itself is now quite broad, so are the technical domains and challenges involved, ranging from integrating support for bleeding‑edge hardware into the latest Ubuntu kernels, to expanding the range of execution environments available to Ubuntu, to the complexities inherent in applying the latest fixes and updates to all of the >100 Ubuntu Linux kernels under active support during our Stable Release Update cycles.

This role would suit either an experienced manager of high‑performing software development teams, or a very proficient technical lead who is excited to take on a management responsibility. You will need to be passionate about Linux and aspire to be an integral part in its distribution to millions of users worldwide.

The role entails

  • Leading a distributed team of software engineers in your geographic region in distinct aspects of delivery of all Linux kernels for the Ubuntu Linux distribution.
  • Taking ownership of particular aspects of Ubuntu Linux which can include but not be limited to:
    • Working with silicon or cloud partners to implement Linux kernels optimised for their execution environments.
    • Ensuring Ubuntu Linux is able to run on a wide range of diverse hardware platforms.
    • Definition and execution of the stringent quality control standards expected by the Ubuntu user community.
    • Mitigation of the latest security threats and exploits to the Linux kernel.
    • Strong process automation as it pertains to the build, test, and delivery of the Linux kernel.
  • Engagement with other teams at Canonical, the open source community and commercial partners.

What we are looking for in you

  • Significant programming experience in C, with Python, Golang, or other like languages is also highly regarded.
  • Substantial experience with operating system kernel internals and concepts, Linux would be highly regarded but not essential.
  • Demonstrated experience managing or leading a team of software engineers.
  • Ability to coordinate between multiple distinct teams of differing technical focus to achieve common goals.
  • Familiarity with version control practices, ideally with git.
  • Prior experience developing with software packaging formats, with direct Ubuntu/Debian/Snap experience being highly regarded.
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills.
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long.

Nice-to-have skills

  • Demonstrated experience with kernel patching and debugging.
  • Strong grasp of device drivers, BSPs, and other low‑level system engineering.
  • Solid background in driving CI/CD and process automation initiatives.
  • Prior public involvement with an open source project.

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person.
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.
  • Annual compensation review.
  • Recognition rewards.
  • Annual holiday leave.
  • Maternity and paternity leave.
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform.
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events.

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Seniority level: Mid‑Senior level

Employment type: Full‑time

Job function: Engineering and Information Technology

This global leadership role in cyber security is to manage the Security Operations (SecOps) team responsible for design, implementation and evolution of Canonical security practices, techniques, tools, systems and policies. The team is the primary owner of strategy and practices that determine how Canonical secures its data, internal infrastructure and build processes. They are responsible for assuring the security and integrity of our own infrastructure and product deployments. They design and implement technical security controls that ensure security threats are automatically identified, contained and remediated. The team will also contribute ideas and requirements for Canonical product security, improving the resilience and robustness of all Ubuntu customers and users subject to cyber attack.
As a leader on cyber security in the company, the SecOps team manager will collaborate with our Organisational Learning and Development team to develop playbooks and facilitate SecOps training across Canonical. They will operate in a wider security organisation, run a high performing security team and improve Canonical's security posture. They will lead initiatives to integrate the team's insights into Canonical's broader software development process.
While this is a management position, we expect managers to be expert practitioners, able to lead by example, contribute at the highest level, and assess work based on their own professional experience and skill. Candidates should have deep, hands-on expertise with a range of open source and proprietary security tooling and practices, which they can integrate into a holistic next generation security solution across the breadth of Canonical's interests.
The SecOps team's mission is not only to secure Canonical, but also to contribute to the security of the wider open source ecosystem. They might share knowledge through public presentations and industry events, and share threat intelligence with the wider community or represent Canonical in sector-specific governance bodies.
This role reports to the CISO.
What you will do in this role:

  • Hire and mentor a team of outstanding technical security professionals
  • Define Canonical's SecOps security standards and playbooks
  • Own and drive the architecture and design of the SOC
  • Analyse and improve Canonical's security architecture
  • Evaluate, select and implement new security tools and practices
  • Identify, contain and guide the remediation of security threats and cyber attacks
  • Grow the presence and thought leadership of Canonical SecOps practice
  • Contribute to open source threat intelligence initiatives
  • Drive threat modelling, table top exercises and other SecOps practices across Engineering, IS and Canonical
  • Develop Canonical SecOps learning and development materials
  • Publish blog posts, whitepapers and conference presentations
  • Identify, implement and track SecOps KPIs
  • Plan and deliver SecOps work in the framework of Canonical's agile engineering practice
  • Work with Security leadership to present information and influence change
What we are looking for
  • Proven track record of mitigating with advanced threat actors and nation state threats
  • Expert technical understanding of SOCs from the ground up
  • In depth knowledge of SOC architecture and design including strategies for logging, firewalls, network segmentation, honeypots etc
  • Someone who understands how the SOC works not just how to use it
  • Expert in Linux security
  • Ability to define, implement, automate and measure effective incident response playbooks
  • Knowledge of security architecture and market-leading security tools
  • Experience contributing to, and consuming, threat intelligence feeds
  • Experience in security risk management frameworks such as NIST CSF
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Deep personal motivation to be at the forefront of technology security
  • Leadership and management ability
  • Excellent business English writing and presentation skills
  • Confidence to report security performance metrics with accountability for accuracy and completeness
Optional things we value
  • Experience in offensive or defensive security teams with hands-on ability
  • Experience with open source security tools
  • Experience with security standards such as ISO 27001
  • Experience with security posture management of corporate endpoitns

title: GERENTE DE COMPLIANCE
description:
Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

MISSÃO DO CARGO

Garantir a conformidade legal e regulatória da organização por meio do desenvolvimento e implementação de programas eficazes de compliance, com foco em Anticorrupção, Direito da Concorrência e Controles de Comércio Exterior. Atuar na aplicação e monitoramento das normativas em todas as áreas do negócio, fornecendo orientação estratégica para mitigar riscos e assegurar boas práticas corporativas. Manter relacionamento ativo com autoridades brasileiras e órgãos reguladores, assegurando a transparência e integridade das operações. Promover a cultura ética dentro da organização por meio de treinamentos, auditorias e políticas de conformidade.

Qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo em Direito, Administração, Economia, Ciências Contábeis.
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Compliance, Governança ou Direito Público.

Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolvimento e Implementação de Compliance: Atuar na criação e execução de medidas para um programa de conformidade eficaz, focado em Anticorrupção, Direito da Concorrência e Controles de Comércio Exterior. Garantir a aderência dos processos internos às regulamentações vigentes.
  • Consultoria Interna: Auxiliar as áreas do negócio a respeito dos normativos internos, fornecendo orientação sobre questões de compliance. Propor soluções para as demandas de modo a mitigar eventuais riscos.
  • Monitoramento e Revisão de Controles Internos: Avaliar continuamente os controles internos, monitorando a aderência das operações às normativas aplicáveis. Propor melhorias e ajustes para fortalecer a governança e minimizar riscos regulatórios.
  • Elaboração e Revisão de Políticas de Integridade: Auxiliar na revisão periódica, bem como na elaboração de políticas e procedimentos do Programa de Integridade da empresa, de modo a garantir que todos os documentos estejam em conformidade com as legislações aplicáveis e necessidades da empresa.
  • Avaliação de Riscos e Due Diligence: Auxiliar na condução de avaliações de risco corporativo conforme a Lei nº 12.846/2013, garantindo a validação da gerência da área. Executar due diligence em parceiros, fornecedores e terceiros para mitigar riscos de compliance.
  • Suporte em Auditorias Internas e Externas: Atuar como referência técnica nas auditorias, preparando documentações e assegurando o cumprimento dos requisitos normativos. Apoiar a implementação de melhorias em resposta a eventuais não-conformidades.
  • Treinamento e Capacitação em Compliance: Desenvolver e ministrar treinamentos para colaboradores sobre normas, regulamentos e diretrizes do Programa de Integridade. Criar estratégias educacionais para promover a cultura ética na organização.
  • Monitoramento da Conformidade com Regulamentos de Controle de Comércio Exterior: Acompanhar a aplicação dos requisitos regulatórios de controle de comércio exterior, de modo a assegurar que as operações estejam alinhadas às legislações nacionais e internacionais aplicáveis.
  • Relatórios e Indicadores de Compliance: Elaborar relatórios anuais e periódicos com métricas do Programa de Integridade para a Alta Administração (Conselho e Diretoria) e eventuais outros stakeholders. Manter indicadores de performance dos pilares da área para garantir a melhoria contínua.

This platform will significantly enhance their security posture across diverse cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP, etc.) and hybrid environments.

How you'll contribute

  • Conduct in-depth interviews, workshops, and brainstorming sessions to elicit, analyze, and document functional and non-functional requirements for the preventative security platform, always with a keen eye on delivering measurable value.

  • 8+ years of experience working as a Business Analyst, with a strong background in client-facing roles within a consulting environment, ideally with a focus on cybersecurity or platform development.

  • Familiarity with various cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and hybrid infrastructure architectures.

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a cross-functional team in a fast-paced consulting environment, often balancing multiple priorities.
  • Advanced English Level is required for this role, as you will work with US clients. Effective communication in English is essential to deliver the best solutions to our clients and expand your horizons.

title: Enterprise Sales Manager
description:
Enterprise Sales Manager

Job Purpose

The Enterprise Sales Manager is responsible for driving new revenue growth through proactive outreach, prospecting, and pipeline development, while also expanding existing enterprise customer relationships. Leads will be generated through multiple channels, including marketing campaigns, third‑party lead generation, and self‑sourced outreach.

An Enterprise customer is defined as any organisation with 200+ white‑collar employees, and the role will span both national and international client requirements, depending on account footprint and opportunity scope.

This role plays a critical part in positioning IWG’s full suite of solutions to large organisations across multiple markets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Generate profitable new revenue by identifying, prospecting, and converting new Enterprise clients.
  • Develop and maintain a robust pipeline of qualified sales opportunities across multiple sectors and geographies.
  • Conduct strategic outreach through direct engagement, events, and third‑party referrals to identify high‑potential prospects.
  • Own the full sales cycle — from first contact to close — with an emphasis on front‑end activity and deal progression.
  • Create and execute Account Plans to grow wallet share within assigned strategic accounts.
  • Build and maintain executive‑level relationships to gain insight into client needs and translate insights into tailored workspace solutions.
  • Collaborate with brokers, real estate advisors, and consultants to generate opportunities and increase IWG’s market visibility.
  • Partner cross‑functionally with regional Sales, Operations, and Product teams to ensure seamless solution delivery.
  • Continuously gather and share feedback from prospects and clients to improve product‑market fit and go‑to‑market effectiveness.
  • Deliver accurate pipeline forecasts, activity reports, and performance updates.

Required Skills, Experience & Qualifications

  • Proven track record in B2B prospecting, business development, and solution selling.
  • Ability to independently source and qualify leads in complex, consultative sales environments.
  • Strong understanding of the enterprise customer buying journey and long‑cycle deal management.
  • Experience working with and influencing C‑level stakeholders.
  • Background in commercial real estate, enterprise services, or flexible workspace is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated ability to meet and exceed sales targets through self‑generated pipeline.
  • Strong negotiation and contract structuring skills.
  • High level of commercial acumen and results orientation.
  • Comfortable working in global, matrixed organisations with distributed teams.
  • Adaptable, proactive, and confident navigating ambiguity.
  • Willingness to travel internationally as needed.
  • Native Portuguese and fluent/conversational English

About the company

IWG has been at the forefront of flexible working for more than 30 years. With over 3,500 locations around the globe, spanning brands including Regus, Spaces, Signature and HQ, we have made it possible for businesses of all sizes to make the transition to hybrid working, empowering employees to work wherever and whenever is most convenient.

We help more than 8 million people and their businesses to work more productively, supported by a choice of professional, inspiring and collaborative workspaces, communities and services.

As the world’s leading provider of hybrid work solutions, with four times the number of locations compared to its nearest competitor, IWG is already working with over 80% of the Fortune 500 and counts businesses including Amazon, Netflix, EY and Uber amongst its customers.

Companies of all sizes are shifting to flexible working to lower costs, improve employee retention and lower their carbon emissions. The flexible workspace is expected to grow by 600% by 2023, when 30% of all office space will be hybrid. We are growing our network faster than ever to keep up with demand from customers as we work towards our goal of reaching 30,000 centres.

Carbon Neutral Workplaces

IWG’s purpose of helping everyone have a great day at work, while protecting people and the planet is at the heart of everything we do. We are proud to supply all of our customers worldwide with carbon neutral workplaces, and we have a strong climate action plan in place to help us achieve our objective of Net Zero emissions by 2040.

Leading Employer Award IWG is proud to be the recipient of a Leading Employer Award in 2022, 2023, 2024 & 2025. Awarded exclusively to the top 1% of employers, the accolade is testament to our diverse global workforce and the role everyone plays in bringing our purpose, culture and values to life, every single day.
